a: Amar rava: la tema safek chaza safek la chaza. ella vadday chaza, safek mechamat shichvat zera, safek mechamat reiyyay. kevan shennizkak letumea — sefeko tame.
Shichvat zaro temea. lemay? ilema lemagga — mi gara mishshichvat zera detahor? ella zaro shel zav metamme bemassa.

Man shamat leha deamar shichvat zera shel zav metamme bemassa? illema hay tanna, detanya, rabbi eliezer omer: shichvat zaro shel zav eno metamme bemassa, verabbi yehoshua omer: metamme bemassa, lefi shei efshar lah belo tzichtzuche ziva. afillu rabbi yehoshua la amar ella mishshum tzichtzuche ziva, aval beeneh, la amar!
Ella amar rav adda bar ahava: lomar sheen tolin bah.
Sevar rav pappa kammeh derava lememar ayyeyde chulesha hu dechaze. amar leh rava, vehatnan: ger shennitgayyer metamme miyyad beziva! amar leh: en lecha choli gadol mizze.
Ella, tannae hi. detanya: shichvat zera shel zav metamme bemassa kol meet leet. verabbi yose omer: yomo.
Bemay kamippalgi? bedishmuel. dishmuel rame: ketiv: "ki yihye vecha ish asher lo yihye tahor mikkere layla". uchetiv: "lifnot erev yirchatz bammayim".
Man deamar meet leet dayek millifnot erev", veiddach dayek "mikkere layla".
Uman deamar millifnot erev", hachtiv "mikkere layla"! amar lach, orcha dekeri lemete belelya.

Mishna nazir haya shemuel, kedivre rabbi nehoray, shenneemar "umora lo yaale al rosho". neemar beshimshon "umora", veneemar bishmuel "umora". ma "mora" haamura beshimshon — nazir, af "mora" haamura bishmuel — nazir.
Amar rabbi yose: vahalo en mora ella shel basar vadam! amar leh rabbi nehoray: vahalo kevar neemar "vayyomer shemuel ech elech veshama shaul vaharagani", shekkevar haya alav mora shel basar vadam.
Gemara amar leh rav lechiyyay bereh:
b: Chatof uvarech. vechen amar leh rav huna lerabba bereh: chatof uvarech.

Lememra dimvarech adif? vehatanya, rabbi yose omer: gadol haone "amen" yoter min hamevarech. veamar lo rabbi nehoray: hashshamayim! kach hu: teda shehare guleyayrim mitgarin bammilchama, vegibborim notzchin.
Tannae hi, detanya: echad hamevarech veechad haone "amen" bammashma, ella shemmemaharin lamvarech techilla.
Amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina: talmide chachamim marbim shalom baolam, shenneemar: "vechol banayich limmude Adonai verav shelom banayich".
Haderan alach haggoyim en lahem nezirut uselika la massechet nazir

a: Hamekanne leishto, rabbi eliezer omer: mekanne lah al pi shenayim, umashkah al pi ed echad, o al pi atzmo. rabbi yehoshua omer: mekanne lah al pi shenayim, umashkah al pi shenayim.
Ketzad mekanne lah? omer lah bifne shenayim: "al tedabberi im ish peloni", vedibbera immo — adayin hi mutteret levetah umutteret leechol bitruma.
Nichnesa immo levet hasseter veshahata immo kede tumea — asura levetah, vaasura leechol bitruma. veim met — choletzet velo mityaybemet.
Gemara mikkede tanna minnazir salek, may tena deka tane sota?
Kidrabbi. detanya, rabbi omer: lamma nismecha parashat nazir lefarashat sota, lomar lach: shekkol haroe sota bekilkulah — yazzir atzmo min hayyayin.
Velitne sota, vahadar litne nazir! ayyeyde ditna ketubbot utena "hammaddir", tena nedarim. veayyeyde ditna nedarim — tena nazir, dedame lindarim. vekatane sota, kidrabbi.
"Hamekanne", diavad — in, lechattechilla — la. kasavar tanna didan: asur lekannoot.

Amar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak: ki hava patach resh lakish besota, amar hachi: en mezavvevgin lo leadam ishsha ella lefi maasav, shenneemar: "ki lo yanuach shevet haresha al goral hatztzaddikim". amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: vekashin lezavvevgan kikriat yam suf, shenneemar: "elohim moshiv yechidim bayta motzi asirim bakkosharot".

Ini? veha amar rav yehuda amar rav: arbaim yom kodem yetzirat havvalad bat kol yotzet veomeret: bat peloni lifloni, bet peloni lifloni, sede feloni lifloni! la kashya: ha — bezug rishon, ha — bezug sheni.
Rabbi eliezer omer: mekanne lah al pi shenayim vechulei. ad kan la peligi ella bekinnuy usetira, aval betumea — ed echad meheman.
Utenan name: ed echad omer "ani raiti shennitmet" — lo hayta shota.
Middeorayyta menalan dimheman ed echad? detanu rabbanan: "veed en bah", bishnayim hakkatuv medabber.
O eno ella afillu beechad? talmud lomar: "lo yakum ed echad beish".
b: Mimmashma shenneemar "lo yakum ed beish", eni yodea shehu echad? ma talmud lomar "echad"? ze bana av: kol makom shenneemar "ed" — hare kan shenayim, ad sheyyifrot lecha hakkatuv "echad".
Veamar rachamana: tere let ba ella chad, "vehi lo nitpasa" — asura.
Ella tama dichtiv "lo yakum ed echad beish", ha lav hachi hava amena "ed" desota chad hu. vei afillu chad lekka, ella bemay mittasra?
Itzterich, salka datach amena: "ed en bah" — en neeman bah.
En neeman bah?! veella may bae —
Ad deikka tere? lishtok kera minneh. deatya "davar" "davar" mimmamon. vaana yadana, midde dehave akkol eduyot shebbattora!
Itzterich, salka datach amena: sota shane, deraglayim ledavar, shehare kinne lah venistera — litheman ba ed echad.
Umi matzet amrat deen neeman bah vesharya? veha middichtiv "vehi lo nitpasa" — mikkelal daasura!
Itzterich, salka datach amena: en neeman bah — ad deikka tere, uvitre name "hi delo nitpasa", ka mashma lan.
Rabbi yehoshua omer: mekanne lah al pi shenayim vechulei. may tama derabbi yehoshua? amar kera: "bah" — bah velo bekinnuy, "bah" — velo bistira.
Verabbi eliezer omer: "bah" — velo bekinnuy.
Veema: "bah" velo bistira! setira ittakkash letumea, dichtiv: "venistera vehi nitmaa".
Kinnuy name ittakkash letumea, dichtiv: "vekinne et ishto vehi nitmaa"! ha miet rachamana "bah".
Uma raita? mistabbera setira adifa, shekken osartah ketumea.
Adderabba: kinnuy adif, shekken ikkar garam lah.
I lav setira, kinnuy mi ikka? vei lav kinnuy, setira may ahani?
Afillu hachi, setira adifa, deatchalta detumea hi.

Matnitin dela ki hay tanna. detanya, rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi eliezer: hamekanne leishto — mekanne al pi ed echad o al pi atzmo, umashke lah al pi shenayim. heshivu chachamim: ledivre rabbi yose berabbi yehuda en laddavar sof.
May tama derabbi yose berabbi yehuda? amar kera "bah" — bah velo bistira.
Veema: "bah" velo bekinnuy? kinnuy ittakkash letumea, dichtiv: "vekinne et ishto vehi nitmaa".
Setira name ittakkash letumea, dichtiv: "venistera vehi nitmaa"?! hahu, lechamma shiur setira — kede tumea, hu daata.
Heshivu chachamim: ledivre rabbi yose berabbi yehuda en laddavar sof. may nihu? dezimnin dela kanni veamar "kannay".
Ha lemishnatenu yesh laddavar sof? zimnin dela istattar veamar "istattar"!
Amar rav yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan: af ledivre rabbi yose berabbi yehuda en laddavar sof.
Af ledivre rabbi yose berabbi yehuda, velo mibbaya lemishnatenu? adderabba: lemishnatenu ikka ikkar, hatam lekka ikkar!
Ella i ittemar — hachi ittemar, amar rav yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan: ledivre rabbi yose berabbi yehuda, af lemishnatenu en laddavar sof.

Amar rav chanina missura: la lema inish leitteteh bazzeman hazze "lo tissatri bahade feloni", dilma kayyma lan kerabbi yose berabbi yehuda, deamar kinnuy al pi atzmo, umistattera, velekka haiddana me sota lemivdeka, vekaasar la illaveh issura dilolam.

Amar resh lakish: ma leshon "kinnuy" — davar hammetil kina benah leven acherim. alma kasavar kinnuy al pi atzmo, vechulle alma la yadi dekanni la, veamri: may dekamma deka badla, veatu lemibad kina bahada.
Verav yemar bar rabbi shelemya mishshemeh deabbaye amar: davar hammetil kina beno levenah. alma kasavar kinnuy al pi shenayim edim, vechulle alma yadi dekanni la, veihu hu deate lemibad kina bahada.

a: Alma kasavri deasur lekannoot.
Uman deamar muttar lekannoot, mahu leshon "kinnuy"? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: en "kinnuy" ella leshon hateraa, vechen hu omer: "vaykanne Adonai leartzo".

Tanya, haya rabbi meir omer: adam over avera basseter vehakkadosh baruch hu machriz alav begaluy, shenneemar: "veavar alav ruach kina", veen avera ella leshon hacheraza, shenneemar: "vaytzav moshe vayyaaviru kol bammachane".
Resh lakish amar: en adam over avera ella im ken nichnas bo ruach shetut, shenneemar: "ish ish ki tiste ishto", "tishte" ketiv.
Tana deve rabbi yishmael: mippene ma heemina tora ed echad besota — sheraglayim laddavar, shehare kinne lah, venistera, veed echad meidah shehi temea.
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: veha ki ketiva kinnuy, batar setira vetumea hu dichtiva!
Amar leh: "veavar" — uchevar avar.
Ella meatta: "veavar lachem kol chalutz", hachi name?
Hatam, middichtiv "venichbesha haaretz lifne Adonai veachar tashuvu" — mashma dilhabba. ella hacha, i salka datach kedichtivi, "veavar" batar tumea usetira — kinnuy lema li?
Tana deve rabbi yishmael: en adam mekanne leishto ella im ken nichnesa bo ruach, shenneemar: "veavar alav ruach kina vekinne et ishto". may ruach?
Rabbanan amri: ruach tumea. rav ashe amar: ruach tohora.

Umistabbera keman deamar ruach tohora. detanya: "vekinne et ishto" — reshut, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: chova. i amrat bishlama ruach tohora — shappir, ella i amrat ruach tumea, reshut vechova leayyole leinish ruach tumea benafsheh?
Gufa: "vekinne et ishto" — reshut, divre rabbi yishmael. verabbi akiva omer: chova. "lah yittamma" — reshut, divre rabbi yishmael. verabbi akiva omer: chova.
"Leolam bahem taavodu" — reshut, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: chova.
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye, veamri la rav mesharsheya lerava: lema rabbi yishmael verabbi akiva bechol hattora kullah hachi peligi, demar amar reshut umar amar chova? amar leh: hacha bikrae peligi.
"Vekinne et ishto" — reshut, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: chova.

May tama derabbi yishmael — savar la ki hay tanna, detanya, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: kelappe sheamra tora "lo tisna et achicha bilvavecha", yachol kegon zo? talmud lomar: "veavar alav ruach kina vekinne et ishto".
Verabbi akiva: kinnuy acharina ketiv.
Verabbi yishmael? ayyeyde devae lemichtav "vehi nitmaa" "vehi lo nitmaa" — ketiv name "vekinne et ishto".
Lechidtana deve rabbi yishmael. detana deve rabbi yishmael: kol parasha shenneemra venishnet — lo nishnet ella bishvil davar shennitchaddesh bah.
"Lah yittamma" — reshut, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: chova.
May tama derabbi yishmael — ayyeyde dichtiv: "emor el hakkohanim bene aharon veamarta alehem lenefesh lo yittamma beammav", itztericha lemichtav "lah yittamma".
Verabbi akiva mikki im lishero" nafka, "lah yittamma" lema li — lechova.
Verabbi yishmael: lah mittamme, veen mittamme leevareha.
b: Verabbi akiva — im ken, lichtov rachamana "lah" velishtok, "yittamma" lema li? shema minna.

Verabbi yishmael, ayyeyde dichtav "lah", ketav name "yittamma". lechidtane deve rabbi yishmael. detana deve rabbi yishmael: kol parasha shenneemra venishnet, lo nishnet ella bishvil davar shennitchaddesh bah.
"Leolam bahem taavodu" — reshut, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: chova.

May tama derabbi yishmael — ayyeyde dichtiv "lo techayye kol neshama", itzterich name lemichtav "leolam bahem taavodu", lemishre echad mikkol haummot shebba al hakkenaanit veholid mimmenna ben, sheatta rashshay liknoto.
Detanya: minnayin leechad min haummot shebba al hakkenaanit veholid mimmenna ben, sheatta rashshay liknoto beeved, talmud lomar: "vegam mibbene hattoshavim haggarim immachem mehem tiknu".

Yachol af hakkenaani shebba al achat min haummot veholid mimmenna ben, sheatta rashshay liknoto beeved, talmud lomar: "asher holidu beartzechem", min hannoladim beartzechem, velo min haggarim beartzechem.
Verabbi akiva mimmehem tiknu" nafka, "leolam bahem taavodu" lema li — lechova.
Verabbi yishmael: "bahem" — velo beachechem.
Verabbi akiva: beachechem — missefa dikra nafka: "uveachechem bene yisrael ish beachiv lo tirde vo befarech".

Verabbi yishmael: ayyeyde dichtiv "uveachechem", ketiv name "bahem". lechidtane deve rabbi yishmael. detana deve rabbi yishmael: kol parasha shenneemra venishnet, lo nishnet ella bishvil davar shennitchaddesh bah.
Amar rav chisda: zenuta beveta ki karya leshumeshma. veamar rav chisda: tukepa beveta ki karya leshumeshma. idde veidde beitteta, aval begavra let lan ba.

Veamar rav chisda: battechilla, kodem shechatu yisrael, hayta shechina shora im kol echad veechad, shenneemar: "ki Adonai elohecha mithallech bekerev machanecha". kevan shechatu nistalleka shechina mehem, shenneemar: "velo yire vecha ervat davar veshav meacharecha".

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: kol haose mitzva achat baolam hazze — mekaddamto veholechet lefanav laolam habba, shenneemar: "vehalach lefanecha tzidkecha". vechol haover avera achat baolam hazze — melappafto veholechet lefanav leyom haddin, shenneemar: "yillaftu orchot darkam yaalu vattohu veyovedu".
Rabbi elazar omer: keshura bo kechelev, shenneemar: "velo shama eleha lishkav etzlah lihyot immah". "lishkav etzlah" — baolam hazze, "lihyot immah" — laolam habba.
Tenan hatam, shehaya baddin:
Uma edut harishona, sheen osartah issur olam — enah mitkayyemet befachot mishshenayim, edut haacharona, sheosartah issur olam — eno din shello titkayyem befachot mishshenayim?
Talmud lomar: "veed en bah", kol sheyyesh bah.
Vekal vachomer leedut harishona meatta: uma edut haacharona, sheosartah issur olam — mitkayyemet beed echad, edut harishona, sheen osartah issur olam — eno din shettitkayyem beed echad?
Talmud lomar: "ki matza vah ervat davar", ulehallan hu omer "al pi shene edim o al pi shelosha edim yakum davar". ma "davar" haamur lehallan — al pi shenayim edim, af kan — al pi shenayim.
Hay mikki matza vah ervat davar" nafka? mibbah" nafka: bah — velo bekinnuy, bah — velo bistira mibbee leh!
Hachi name kaamar: talmud lomar "bah": bah — velo bekinnuy, bah — velo bistira.

Vetumea bealma belo kinnuy uvelo setira, dela meheman ed echad, menalan? neemar kan: "ki matza vah ervat davar", veneemar lehallan: "al pi shene edim o al pi shelosha edim yakum davar". ma "davar" haamur lehallan — edim shenayim, af kan — edim shenayim.
Tanu rabbanan: e zo hi edut harishona — zo edut setira, edut acharona — zo edut tumea.

a: Vechamma shiur setira? kede tumea, kede via, kede haaraa.
Kede hakkafat dekel, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi eliezer omer: kede mezigat hakkos. rabbi yehoshua omer: kede lishtoto.
Ben azzay omer: kede litzlot betza. rabbi akiva omer: kede legomah. rabbi yehuda ben betera omer: kede ligmoa shalosh betzim zo achar zo. rabbi elazar ben yirmeya omer: kede likshor gardi nima.

Chanin ben pinchas omer: kede shettoshit yadah letoch piha littol kesam. pelemo omer: kede shettoshit yadah lassal littol kikkar. af al pi sheen reaya laddavar, zecher laddavar: "ki vead ishsha zona ad kikkar lachem".
Vechol hane lema li?
Tzerichi, dei tena kede tumea, hava amena: kede tumeatah veartzutah, ka mashma lan kede via.
Vei tena kede via, hava amena: kede gemar bia, ka mashma lan kede haaraa.
Vei ashmeinan kede haaraa, hava amena: kede haaraa veartzutah, ka mashma lan kede tumea. vechamma kede [haaraa] — kede hakkafat dekel.
Ureminhi "venistera", vechamma shiur setira lo shamanu. keshehu omer "vehi nitmaa", heve omer — kede tumea, kede via, kede haaraa, kede chazarat dekel, divre rabbi eliezer.
Rabbi yehoshua omer: kede mezigat hakkos. ben azzay omer: kede lishtoto. rabbi akiva omer: kede litzlot betza. rabbi yehuda ben betera omer: kede legomah.
Ka salka datin: hayeynu hakkafat dekel, hayeynu chazarat dekel. hatam amar rabbi yishmael: kede hakkafat dekel, ufelig rabbi eliezer aleh. hacha amar rabbi eliezer kede chazarat dekel!
Amar abbaye: hakkafa baregel, chazara baruach.
Bae rav ashe: chazara baruach ki hechi deazel vahadar ate, o dilma ki hechi deazel veate vahadar kae beducheteh. teku.
Hatam amar rabbi eliezer: kede mezigat hakkos, hacha: kede chazarat dekel! idde veidde chad shiura hu.
Hatam amar rabbi yehoshua: kede lishtoto, hacha amar: kede mezigat hakkos! ema kede limzog velishtot. velema: idde veidde chad shiura hu! im ken, hayeynu rabbi eliezer.
Hatam amar ben azzay: kede litzlot betza, hacha amar: kede lishtoto. idde veidde chad shiura hu.
Hatam amar rabbi akiva: kede legomah, hacha amar: kede litzlot betza! ema kede litzlot betza ulegomah. velema: idde veidde chad shiura hu! im ken, hayeynu ben azzay.

Hatam amar rabbi yehuda ben betera: kede ligmoa shalosh betzim zo achar zo, hacha amar: kede legomah! lidvarav derabbi akiva kaamar, dekaamar meshaarin bitzlia uvigmia: ema shiur gemia lechoda kede ligmoa shalosh betzim zo achar zo, dehayynu tzelia ugemia.
Rabbi elazar ben yirmeya omer: kede sheyyikshor gardi nima. bae rav ashe: dimrachak, o dimkarav? teku.
Chanin ben pinchas omer: kede shettoshit yadah letoch piha littol kesam. bae rav ashe: dimhaddak o dela mehaddak? teku.
Pelemo omer: kede shettoshit yadah lassal littol kikkar. bae rav ashe: dimhaddak o dela mehaddak? bechadta o beattika? bechammima o bekarira?
b: Bidchitte o bedisare? berakkicha o baakosha? teku.
Amar rav yitzchak bar rav yosef amar rabbi yochanan: kol echad veechad — beatzmo shier. vehaikka ben azzay dela nesev?
Ibbaet ema: nesev uferash hava. veibbaet ema: merabbeh shemia leh. veibbaet ema: "sod Adonai lireav".

Daresh rav avvira, zimnin amar la mishshemeh derabbi amme, vezimnin amar la mishshemeh derabbi assi: kol haochel lechem belo netilat yadayim — keillu ba al ishsha zona. shenneemar: "ki vead ishsha zona ad kikkar lachem".
Amar rava: hay "bead ishsha zona ad kikkar lachem" — "bead kikkar lechem ad ishsha zona" mibbee leh! ella amar rava: kol habba al ishsha zona, lesof mevakkesh kikkar lechem.

Amar rabbi zerika amar rabbi elazar: kol hammezalzel bintilat yadayim neekar min haolam. amar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: mayim rishonim — tzarich sheyyagbiah yadav lemala, mayim acharonim — tzarich sheyyashpil yadav lematta. tanya name hachi: hannotel yadav — tzarich sheyyagbiah yadav lemala, shemma yetzu hammayim chutz lapperek, veyachzeru vitammeu et hayyadayim.
Amar rabbi avahu: kol haochel pat belo nigguv yadayim — keillu ochel lechem tame, shenneemar: "vayyomer Adonai kacha yochlu vene yisrael et lachmam tame vegomer".

Umay "veeshet ish nefesh yekara tatzud"? amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: kol adam sheyyesh bo gassut haruach — levassof nichshal beeshet ish, shenneemar: "veeshet ish nefesh yekara tatzud".

Amar rava: hay "nefesh yekara" — "nefesh gevoha" mibbee leh. veod: "hi tatzud" mibbee leh! ella amar rava: kol habba al eshet ish, afillu lamad tora dichtiv ba "yekara hi mippeninim", mikkohen gadol shennichnas lifnay velifnim, "hi tetzudennu" — ledinah shel gehinnam.

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: kol adam sheyyesh bo gassut haruach — keillu oved avoda zara. ketiv hacha: "toavat Adonai kol geva lev", uchetiv hatam: "vela tavi toeva el betecha".
Verabbi yochanan dideh amar: keillu kafar baikkar, shenneemar: "veram levavecha veshachachta et Adonai elohecha vegomer".
Rabbi chama bar chanina amar: keillu ba al kol haarayot. ketiv hacha: "toavat Adonai kol geva lev", uchetiv hatam: "ki et kol hattoevot hael vegomer".
Ulla amar: keillu bana bama, shenneemar: "chidlu lachem min haadam asher neshama beappo ki bamme nechshav hu" — al tikre "bamme", ella "bama".

May "yad leyad lo yinnake"? amar rav: kol habba al eshet ish, afillu hiknahu lehakkadosh baruch hu shamayim vaaretz keavraham avinu, dichtiv beh: "harimoti yadi el Adonai el elyon kone shamayim vaaretz" — lo yinnake middinah shel gehinnam.
Kashya lehu lidve rabbi shela: hay "yad leyad lo yinnake", "yadi" mibbee leh!
Ella amri deve rabbi shela: afillu kibbel tora kemoshe rabbenu, dichtiv beh "mimino esh dat lamo" — lo yinnake middinah shel gehinnam.
Kashya leh lerabbi yochanan: hay "yad leyad", "yad miyyad" mibbaya leh!
Ella amar rabbi yochanan:

a: Afillu ose tzedaka basseter, dichtiv: "mattan basseter yichpe af vegomer" — lo yinnake middinah shel gehinnam.

Azhara legasse haruach minnayin? amar rava amar zeeri: "shimu vehaazinu al tigbahu". rav nachman bar yitzchak amar, mehacha: "veram levavecha veshachachta" uchetiv: "hishshamer lecha pen tishkach et Adonai elohecha".
Vechidrabbi avin amar rabbi ila. deamar rabbi avin amar rabbi ila: kol makom shenneemar "hishshamer" "pen" veal" — eno ella belo taase.

Daresh rav avvira, zimnin amar la mishshemeh derav assi vezimnin amar la mishshemeh derav amme: kol adam sheyyesh bo gassut haruach lesof mitmaet, shenneemar: "rommu meat". veshemma tomar yeshno baolam, talmud lomar: "veenennu".

Veim chozer bo — neesaf bizmanno keavraham avinu, shenneemar: "vehummechu kakkol yikkaftzun". keavraham yitzchak veyaakov dichtiv behu: "bakkol", "mikkol", "kol". veim lav — "ucherosh shibbolet yimmalu".

May "ucherosh shibbolet"? rav huna verav chisda, chad amar: ki sasa deshibbalta, vechad amar: keshibbolet atzmah. bishlama leman deamar ki sasa deshibbalta — hayeynu dichtiv: "ucherosh shibbolet", ella leman deamar ki shubbalta atzmah, may "ucherosh shibbolet"? amar rav assi, vechen tana deve rabbi yishmael: mashal leadam shennichnas letoch sadehu — gevoha gevoha hu melakket.
"Veet dakka ushefal ruach". rav huna verav chisda, chad amar: itti dakka, vechad amar: ani et dakka.
Umistabbera keman deamar ani et dakka, shehare hakkadosh baruch hu hinniach kol harim ugevaot, vehishra shechinato al har sinay velo gava har sinay lemala.
Amar rav yosef: leolam yilmad adam middaat kono, shehare hakkadosh baruch hu hinniach kol harim ugevaot, vehishra shechinato al har sinay. vehinniach kol ilanot tovot, vehishra shechinato bassene.
Amar rabbi elazar: kol adam sheyyesh bo gassut haruach rauy legaddeo kaashera. ketiv hacha: "verame hakkoma geduim", uchetiv hatam: "vaasherehem tegaddeun".

Veamar rabbi elazar: kol adam sheyyesh bo gassut haruach — en afaro ninar, shenneemar: "hakitzu verannenu shochne afar", "shochve beafar" lo neemar, ella "shochne afar" — mi shennaasa shachen leafar bechayyav.
Veamar rabbi elazar: kol adam sheyyesh bo gassut haruach, shechina meyallelet alav, shenneemar: "vegavoah mimmerchak yeyeda".

Daresh rav avvira, veittema rabbi elazar: bo uree shello kemiddat hakkadosh baruch hu middat basar vedam. middat basar vadam — gavoah roe et haggavoah, veen gavoah roe et hashshafel. aval middat hakkadosh baruch hu eno ken, hu gavoah veroe et hashshafel, shenneemar: "ki ram Adonai veshafal yire".

Amar rav chisda, veittema mar ukeva: kol adam sheyyesh bo gassut haruach, amar hakkadosh baruch hu: en ani vahu yecholin ladur baolam, shenneemar: "meloshni vasseter reehu oto atzmit geva enayim urechav levav oto lo uchol". al tikre "oto", ella "itto lo uchol". ikka dematne la ammesappere lashon hara, shenneemar: "meloshni vasseter reehu oto atzmit".

Amar rabbi alekkesanderi: kol adam sheyyesh bo gassut haruach, afillu ruach kima ocharto, shenneemar: "veharshaim kayyam nigrash", uma yam sheyyesh bo kamma reviiyyot — ruach kima ocharto, adam sheen bo ella reviit achat — al achat kamma vechamma.

Amar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: talmid chacham tzarich sheyyehe bo echad mishshemona bishminit. amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: umeattera leh ki sasa leshubbalta. amar rava: beshamta deit beh, uveshamta delet beh.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: la minna vela miktzata, mi zutar dichtiv beh "toavat Adonai kol geva lev"?
Amar chizkiyya: en tefillato shel adam nishmaat ella im ken mesim libbo kevasar, shenneemar: "vehaya midde chodesh bechodsho [vegomer] yavo kol basar lehishtachavot vegomer".
Amar rabbi zera: "basar" ketiv beh "venirpa", "adam" la ketiv beh "venirpa".
Amar rabbi yochanan, adam: efer, dam, mara. basar: busha, serucha, rimma. ikka deamri: sheol, dichtiv beshin.
Amar rav ashe: kol adam sheyyesh bo gassut haruach lesof nifchat, shenneemar:
b: "Velaset velassappachat", veen "seet" ella leshon gavoah, shenneemar: "veal [kol] heharim haramim veal [kol] haggevaot hannissaot", veen "sappachat" ella tefela, shenneemar: "sefacheni na el achat hakkehunnot leechol pat lachem".

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: bo uree kamma gedolim nemuche haruach lifne hakkadosh baruch hu, shebbeshaa shebbet hammikdash kayyaym adam makriv ola — sechar ola beyado. mincha — sechar mincha beyado. aval mi sheddato shefala, maale alav hakkatuv keillu hikriv kol hakkarbanot kullam, shenneemar: "zivche elohim ruach nishbara". velo od, ella sheen tefillato nimeset, shenneemar: "lev nishbar venidke elohim lo tivze".

Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol hashsham orchotav baolam hazze — zoche veroe bishuato shel hakkadosh baruch hu, shenneemar: "vesam derech arennu beyesha elohim", al tikre "vesam", ella "vesham derech".
[Ketzad mekanne lah kulei.] ha gufa kashya: amrat, amar lah bifne shenayim al tedabberi im ish peloni ze, alma dibbur setira hu,
Vahadar tane: dibbera immo — adayin mutteret levetah umutteret leechol bitruma, alma dibbur la kelum hu!

Amar abbaye, hachi kaamar: "al tedabberi" vedibbera, "al tedabberi" venistera — velo kelum. "al tissatri" vedibbera immo — adayin mutteret levetah umutteret leechol bitruma. nichnesa immo levet hasseter veshahata kede tumea, asura levetah vaasura leechol bitruma.
Veim met choletzet. ammay? tityaybem name yabbome?
Amar rav yosef, amar kera: "veyatza mibbeto vehalcha vehayta leish acher". leish acher, velo layyavam.
Amar leh abbaye: ella meatta — chalitza name la tive! amar leh: illu iteh levaal, mi la baaya get? hasheta name tive chalitza.
Veit deamri, amar rav yosef: rachamana amar "veyatza mibbeto vehalcha vehayta leish acher" — dela listereh leveteh, veat amrat tityaybem name yabbome?!
Amar leh abbaye: ella meatta, leacher la tinnase, dela tistereh leveteh!
Amar leh:

a: Mi ka ramenan la aleh beal kurcheh?
Veikka deamri, amar rav yosef: hakkatuv kerao "acher", sheen ben zugo shel rishon. shezze hotzi reshaa mibbeto, veze hichnis reshaa letoch beto, veat amrat tityabbem name yabbome?!
Amar leh abbaye: ella meatta, nisset leacher umet belo banim — lo tityabbem, dehakkatuv kerao "acher"! gabbeh dehay miha beshem tov hava kayyma.
Rava amar, kal vachomer: im neesra bammuttar lah — baasur lah lo kol shekken?
Amar leh abbaye: ella meatta, kohen gadol shekkiddesh et haalmana vamet, veyesh lo ach kohen hedyot, lo tityabbem: im neesra bammuttar lah — baasur lah lo kol shekken?!
Neesra?! ha asira vekayyma! muttar lah?! asur lah hu!
Ella: eshet kohen shenneensa vamet, veyesh lo ach chalal — lo tityabbem. im neesra bammuttar lah — baasur lah lo kol shekken?!
Ones beyisrael mishre shere, vegabbe dehay miha lekka issura.
Mishna veellu asurot milleechol bitruma: haomeret "temea ani lach", veshebbau edim shehi temea, vehaomeret "eni shota", veshebbalah eno rotze lehashekotah, veshebbalah ba aleha badderech.

Gemara amar rav amram: ha milleta amar lan rav sheshet, veanhar lan ayynin mimmatnitin: sota sheyyesh lah edim bimdinat hayyam — en hammayim bodkin otah. may tama? deamar kera "venistera vehi nitmaa veed en bah", delekka deyada bah. leappoke ha, deha ikka deyada bah.
Veanhar lan ayynin mimmatnitin, dekatane: veshebbau lah edim shehi temea. daatu edim emat? i nema mikkamme detishte — zona hi!
Ella levatar dishtay. i amrat bishlama en hammayim bodkin otah — shappir. ella i amrat mayim bodkin otah — tiggalle milleta lemafrea desahade shakkare ninhu!
Amar leh rav yosef: leolam ema lecha mayim bodkin otah, veha — emor zechut tola lah.
Bemay kamippalgi — bemitnavvevna derabbi. ditnan, rabbi omer: zechut tola bammayim hammarim, veenah yoledet veenah mashbachat, ella mitnavvevna veholechet, lesof shehi meta beotah mita.
Rav sheshet savar: ben lerabbi uven lerabbanan havya mitnavvevna. verav yosef savar: lerabbi havya mitnavvevna, lerabbanan la havya mitnavvevna.

Metiv rav shimi bar ashe, rabbi shimon omer: en zechut tola bammayim hammarim. veim atta omer zechut tola bammayim hammarim — medache atta et hammayim bifne kol hannashim hashshotot. veatta motzi shem ra al hattehorot sheshshatu, vehen omrim: temeot hayu, ella shettala lahen zechut.
Veim ita yesh lah edim bimdinat hayyam name: atta motzi shem ra al hattehorot sheshshatu, vehen omrim: temeot hayu, ella sheyyesh lahen edim bimdinat hayyam!
Lerabbi shimon kaamrat? lerabbi shimon, middizchut la talya — edim name la talu.
Metiv rav: veellu shemminchotehen nisrafot,
b: Haomeret "temea ani", veshebbau lah edim shehi temea.
Daato edim emat? illema mikkamme detikdosh — tippok lechullin.
Ella levatar dikdush. i amrat bishlama mayim bodkin otah — alma bat mikdash umikrav hi, vechi kedush meikkara — shappir kedush, umishshum hachi minchatah nisrefet.
Ella i amrat en hammayim bodkin otah, tiggalle milleta lemafrea dechi kedush meikkara — betaut kedush, vetippok lechullin!
Amar rav yehuda middiskarta: kegon shezzinneta baazara, dechi kedush meikkara — shappir kedush.
Matkef la rav mesharsheya: vahalo pirche chehunna melavvin otah! shezzinneta mippirche chehunna atzman.
Rav ashe amar: kegon shennitzrecha linkaveha, deattu pirche chehunna bechippa tale la?
Rav pappa amar: leolam kidamrinan meikkara, udekaamrat tippok lechullin — midderabbanan, gezera shemma yomru: motziin mikkele sharet lechol.
Metiv rav mari: nitmet minchatah ad shello kadsha bichli — hare hi kechol hammenachot, vetippade. mishshekkadsha bichli — hare hi kechol hammenachot, vetissaref.
Kadash hakkometz, velo hispik lehakerivo ad shemmet hu o ad shemmeta hi — hare hi kechol hammenachot, vetissaref.
Karav hakkometz velo hispik leechol shirayim ad shemmet hu o ad shemmeta hi — hare hi kechol hammenachot, veteachel. sheal hassafek bat mittechilla, kippera sefekah vehalcha lah.
Bau lah edim shehi temea — minchatah nisrefet. nimtzeu edeha zommin — minchatah chullin.
Edim zommin kaamrat?! edim zommin kala it lehu.
Tanya kevoteh derav sheshet, velav mittameh.
"Tehora" — velo sheyyesh lah edim bimdinat hayyam.
"Utehora" — velo shettalta lah zechut.
"Hi" — velo sheyyisu veyittenu bah mozrot ballevana.
Verabbi shimon, nehi devav la daresh, veha ikka

a: Yesh lah edim bimdinat hayyam!
La shechicha.
Mishna ketzad ose lah? molichah levet din shebbeoto makom, umosrin lo shene talmide chachamim, shemma yavo aleha badderech. rabbi yehuda omer: balah neeman aleha.

Gemara tere veihu — ha telata. lema mesayyay leh lerav. deamar rav yehuda amar rav: lo shanu ella bair, aval badderech — ad deikka shelosha, shemma yitztarech echad mehen linkavav, venimtza echad mehen mityayched im haerva.
La: hacha hayeynu tama ki hechi delihvo aleh sahadi.

Talmide chachamim — in, kulle alma — la. lema mesayyay leh leiddach derav, deamar rav yehuda amar rav: lo shanu ella kesherin, aval perutzin, afillu asara name la. maase haya vehotziuha asara bemitta.
La, hacha hayeynu tama — deyadi leatroye beh.
Rabbi yehuda omer: balah vechulei. tanya, rabbi yehuda omer, balah neeman mikkal vachomer: uma nidda shehi becharet — balah neeman aleha, sota shehi belav — lo kol shekken?!
Verabbanan, hi hannotenet: nidda decharet — chamira leh umeheman. sota delav — la chamira leh, vela meheman.

Verabbi yehuda mikkal vachomer mayyte la? veha rabbi yehuda mikkerae mayyte la! detanya: "vehevi haish et ishto el hakkohen". min hattora haish mevi et ishto, aval amru chachamim: mosrin lo shene talmide chachamim, shemma yavo aleha badderech.
Rabbi yose omer, balah neeman aleha mikkal vachomer: uma nidda shehi becharet — balah neeman aleha, sota shehi belav — lo kol shekken?!
Amru lo: lo, im amarta benidda — shekken yesh lah hetter, tomar besota — sheen lah hetter, veomer: "mayim genuvim yimtaku vegomer".
Rabbi yehuda omer: min hattora haish mevi et ishto el hakkohen, shenneemar: "vehevi haish et ishto"!
Amar lehu kal vachomer beresha ufarchu, vahadar amar lehu kera.
Rabbi yehuda hayeynu tanna kamma! ikka benayyhu "aval amru".
Mishna hayu maalin otah levet din haggadol shebbirushalayim, umeayyeymin aleha kederech shemmeayyeymin al ede nefashot.
Veomer lah: bitti, harebe yayin ose, harebe sechok ose, harebe yaldut osa, harebe shechenim haraim osin.
Asi lishmo haggadol shennichtav bikdushsha shello yimmache al hammayim. veomer lefaneha devarim sheenam keday leshoman, hi vechol mishpachat bet aviha.
Im amra "temea ani" — shoveret ketubbatah veyotzet.
Veim amra "tehora ani" — maalin otah leshaar hammizrach sheal petach shaar nikkanor, sheshsham mashkin et hassotot, umetaharin et hayyoldot, umetaharin et hametzorain.

Vechohen ochez bivgadeha. im nikreu — nikreu. veim nifremu — nifremu. ad shehu megalle et libbah. vesoter et searah. rabbi yehuda omer: im haya libbah nae — lo haya megallehu, veim haya searah nae — lo haya soter.
Hayta mitkassa bilvanim — mechasseha bishchorim. haya aleha kele zahav
b: Vekatleot, nezamim vetabbaot — maavirin mimmenna, kede lenavvevlah. veachar kach mevi chevel mitzri vekoshro lemala middaddeha,
Vechol harotze lirot ba lirot, chutz meavadeha veshifchoteha, mippene shellibbah gas bahen. vechol hannashim muttarot lirotah, shenneemar: "venivvasseru kol hannashim velo taasena kezimmatchena".

Gemara menahane mille? amar rabbi chiyyay bar gammada amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: atya "tora" "tora". ketiv hacha: "veasa lah hakkohen et kol hattora", uchetiv hatam: "al pi hattora asher yorucha", ma lehallan beshivim veechad — af kan beshivim veechad.

Umeayyeymin aleha vechulei. ureminhu: kederech shemmeayyeymin aleha shello tishte kach meayyeymin aleha shettishte. omrim lah: bitti, im barur lach haddavar shettehora at imdi al bureyich, usheti. lefi sheen mayim hammarim domin ella lesam yavesh shemmunnach al basar chay. im yesh sham makka — mechalchel veyored, en sham makka — eno moil kelum.
La kashya: kan — kodem shennimchaka megilla. kan — leachar shennimchaka megilla.
Veomer lefaneha vechulei. tanu rabbanan: omer lefaneha devarim shel haggada, umaasim sheeru bichtuvim harishonim, kegon: "asher chachamim yaggidu velo chichadu meavotam".

Yehuda hoda velo bosh, me haya sofo — nachal chayye haolam habba. reuven hoda velo bosh, me haya sofo — nachal chayye haolam habba. uma secharan? ma secharan?! kidka amrinan! ella: ma secharan baolam hazze, "lahem levaddam nittena haaretz velo avar zar betocham".
Bishlama bihuda ashkechan deodi, dichtiv: "vayyakker yehuda vayyomer tzadka mimmenni", ella reuven menalan deodi?
Deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yochanan: may dichtiv "yechi reuven veal yamot", "vezot lihuda"?

Kol otan shanim shehayu yisrael bammidbar, hayu atzmotav shel yehuda megulegalin baaron, ad sheamad moshe uvikkesh alav rachamim. amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, mi garam liruven shehoda — yehuda: "vezot lihuda"?!

Miyyad: "shema Adonai kol yehuda", al evreh leshafa. vela hava ka meayyeylin leh limtivta dirkia, "veel ammo teviennu". vela hava ka yada mishkal umitrach bishmata bahade rabbanan, "yadav rav lo". la hava ka salka leh shemata allibba dehilcheta, "veezer mitztzarav tihye".
Bishlama yehuda deodi, ki hechi delo tissaref tamar. ella reuven, lema leh deodi? vehaamar rav sheshet: chatzif alay dimfaret cheteh? ki hechi dela lichashdu achohi.
Im amra "temea ani" vechulei. shamat minna kotvin shovar.
Amar abbaye, teni: "mekaraat". amar leh rava: veha "shoveret" katane! ella amar rava: bimkom sheen kotvin ketubba askinan.
Veim amra "tehora ani" maalin otah leshaare mizrach. maalin otah?!

a: Hatam kayyma! demassekinan la umachatinan la kede leyaygah. detanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: bet din massiin et haedim mimmakom lemakom, kede shettittaref datan alehen veyachzeru bahen.
Sheshsham mashkin et hassotot vechulei. bishlama sotot, dichtiv: "veheemid hakkohen et haishsha lifne Adonai", metzorain name, dichtiv: "veheemid hakkohen hametaher vegomer", ella yoledet may tama?
Illema mishshum deatyayn vekayymayn akkurebanayyhu, detanya: en korbano shel adam karev ella im ken omed al gabbav. i hachi — zavin vezavot name! in hachi name, vetanna chada minnayyhu nekat.
Tanu rabbanan: en mashkin shete sotot keachat, kede shello yehe libbah gas bachavertah. rabbi yehuda omer: lo min hashshem hu ze, ella amar kera: "otah" — levaddah.
Vetanna kamma, hachtiv "otah"? tanna kamma — rabbi shimon hi, dedaresh taam dikra, uma taam kaamar: ma taam "otah" levaddah — kede shello yehe libbah gas bachavertah.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu rotetet.
Verotetet mi mashkin? veha en osin mitzvot chavilot chavilot.
Ditnan: en mashkin shete sotot keachat, veen metaharin shene metzorain keachat, veen rotzin shene avadim keachat, veen orfin shete agalot keachat, lefi sheen osin mitzvot chavilot chavilot.
Amar abbaye, veittema rav kahana, la kashya: kan bechohen echad, kan bishne kohanim.

Vehakkohen ochez bivgadeha. tanu rabbanan: "ufara et rosh haishsha", en li ella roshah. gufah minnayin — talmud lomar: "haishsha". im ken ma talmud lomar "ufara et roshah" — melammed shehakkohen soter et searah.
Rabbi yehuda omer: im haya libbah vechulei. lememra derabbi yehuda chayesh lehirhura, verabbanan la chayyshi?

Veha ippecha shaminan lehu, detanya: haish, mechassin oto perek echad millefanav, vehaishsha, shene perakim — echad millefaneha veechad milleachareha, mippene shekkullah erva, divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim omrim: haish niskal arom, veen haishsha niskelet arumma!

Amar rabba: hacha tama may — shemma tetze mibbet din zakkait, veyitgaru bah pirche chehunna. hatam — ha mistalleka. vechi tema: ate leiggaroye beachranyayta — haamar rava: gemiri deen yetzer hara sholet ella bema sheenav root.
Amar rava: derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda kashya, derabbanan adderabbanan la kashya? ella amar rava: derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda la kashya, kidshannin.
b: Derabbanan adderabbanan name la kashya. hacha tama may? mishshum "venivvasseru kol hannashim". hatam — en lecha yissur gadol mizze.
Vechi tema laaved ba tarte — amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu, amar kera: "veahavta lereacha kamocha" — beror lo mita yafa.

Lema derav nachman tannae hi? la, dechulle alma it lehu derav nachman. vehacha beha kamippalgi, mar savar: bizyoneh adif leh tefe mitztzara degufeh, umar savar: tzara degufeh adif leh tefe mibbizyoneh.
Hayta mechussa levanim vechulei. tana, im hayu shechorim naim lah — mechassin otah begadim mechoarim.
Hayu aleha kele zahav vechulei. peshita, hasheta nauole menavvevyl la, hane mibbaya? mahu detema: behane it la bizzayon tefe, kidamri inashe: shaliach artil vesayem mesane. ka mashma lan.

Veachar kach mevi chevel vechulei. bea minneh rabbi abba merav huna: chevel hammitzri mahu sheyyeakkev besota? mishshum shello yishshamtu begadeha mealeha hu, uvetziltzol katan name saggi, o dilma mishshum deamar mar "hi chagra lo betziltzol, lefichach kohen mevi chevel hammitzri vekosher lah lemala middaddeha" — meakkev?
Amar leh, tenetuha: veachar kach mevi chevel hammitzri vekoshro lah lemala middaddeha, kede shello yishshamtu begadeha mealeha.

Vechol harotze lirot bah yire vechulei. ha gufa kashya. amrat: kol harotze lirot bah roe, alma la shena gavre vela shena neshe, vahadar tane: kol hannashim muttarot lirotah: nashim — in, anashim — la.
Amar abbaye: targema anashim. amar leh rava: veha "kol harotze lirot bah roe" katane!
Ella amar rava: kol harotze lirot bah roe, la shena gavre vela shena neshe. venashim chayyayvot lirotah, shenneemar: "venivvasseru kol hannashim velo taasena kezimmatchena".

Mishna bemidda sheadam moded — bah moddin lo. hi kishsheta et atzmah laavera — hammakom nivvevlah. hi gilleta et atzmah laavera — hammakom gilla aleha. bayyarech hitchilla baavera techilla veachar kach habbeten — lefichach tilke hayyarech techilla veachar kach habbeten, ushear kol hagguf lo palat.
Gemara amar rav yosef: af al gav demidda betela, bammidda lo batel.
Deamar rav yosef, vechen tane rabbi chiyyay: miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash, af al pi shebbatla sanhedri — arba mitot lo batlu. veha batlu?! ella: din arba mitot lo batlu.

Mi shennitchayyev sekila — o nofel min haggag, o chayya dorasto. mi shennitchayyev serefa — o nofel bidleka, o nachash makkisho. mi shennitchayyev hariga — o nimsar lammalchut, o listin bain alav. mi shennitchayyev chanika — o tovea bannahar, o met bisronche.
Tanya, haya rabbi omer: minnayin shebbemidda sheadam moded bah moddin lo — shenneemar: "besassea beshallechah terivenna".
En li ella sea, minnayin lerabbot tarkav vachatzi tarkav, kav vachatzi kav, rova vachatzi rova, tomen veuchela, minnayin — talmud lomar: "ki kol seon soen beraash".
Uminnayin shekkol peruta uferuta mitztarefet lecheshbon gadol — talmud lomar: "achat leachat limtzo cheshbon".

Vechen matzinu bassota, shebbammidda shemmadda — bah maddu lah: hi amda al petach betah leraot lo — lefichach kohen maamidah al shaar nikkanor umare kelonah lakkol. hi parsa lo sudarin nain al roshah — lefichach kohen notel kippa meal roshah umannicho tachat ragleha. hi kishsheta lo paneha — lefichach

a: Paneha morikot. hi kachala lo eneha — lefichach eneha boltot. hi kala lo et searah — lefichach kohen soter et searah. hi herata lo beetzba — lefichach tzipporneha noshrot. hi chagra lo betziltzol — lefichach kohen mevi chevel hammitzri vekosher lah lemala middaddeha. hi pashta lo et yerechah — lefichach yerechah nofelet.

Hi kibbelattu al keresah — lefichach bitnah tzava. hi heechilattu maadanne olam — lefichach korbanah maachal behema. hi hishkathu yayin meshubbach bechosot meshubbachim — lefichach kohen mashke mayim hammarim bimkidda shel cheres.
Hi asta basseter — "yoshev beseter elyon" sam bah panim, shenneemar: "veen noef shamra neshef lemor lo teshureni ayin vegomer".
Davar acher: hi asta basseter — hammakom pirsema baggaluy, shenneemar: "tikkasse sina bemashshaon tiggale raato vekahal (vegomer)".
Umeachar denafka leh meachat leachat limtzo cheshbon", "ki chol seon soen beraash" lema li? lechammidda.
Umeachar denafka leh mikki chol seon soen beraash", "besassea beshallechah terivenna" lema li?
Lechidrav chinnana bar pappa. deamar rav chinnana bar pappa: en hakkadosh baruch hu nifra min haumma ad sheat shilluchah, shenneemar: "besassea beshallechah vegomer".
Ini? vehaamar rava: shalosh(5) kosot haamurot bemitzrayim, lamma? achat sheshshatat bime moshe, veachat sheshshatat bime paro necho, veachat sheatida lishtot im chavroteha!

Vechi tema hanach azadu vehane acharine ninhu — vehatanya, amar rabbi yehuda: minyamin ger hammitzri haya li chaver mittalmide rabbi akiva. amar minyamin ger hammitzri: ani mitzri rishon, venasati mitzrit rishona, assi livne mitzrit sheniyya kede sheyyehe ben beni muttar lavo bakkahal!
Ella i ittemar hachi ittemar: amar rav chinnana bar pappa: en hakkadosh baruch hu nifra min hammelech ad sheat shillucho, shenneemar: "besassea beshallechah terivenna vegomer".

Ammemar matne leha derav chinnana bar pappa aha, may dichtiv: "ki ani Adonai lo shaniti veattem bene yaakov lo chelitem"? "ani Adonai lo shaniti" — lo hikketi leummah veshaniti lah. "veattem bene yaakov lo chelitem" — hayeynu dichtiv: "chitztzay achalle bam". chitztzay kalin, vehen enan kalin.
Amar rav hamenuna: en hakkadosh baruch hu nifra min haadam ad shettitmalle seato, shenneemar: "bimlovt sifko yetzer lo vegomer".
Daresh rav chinnana bar pappa, may dichtiv: "rannenu tzaddikim baAdonai laysharim nava tehilla"? al tikre "nava tehilla", ella "nave tehilla", ze moshe vedavid, shello shaltu sonehem bemaasehem.

David — dichtiv: "tavu vaaretz sheareha". moshe — deamar mar: mishshennivna mikdash rishon nignaz ohel moed, kerashav kerasav uverichav veammudav vaadanav. hecha? amar rav chisda amar avimi: tachat mechillot shel hechol.

Tanu rabbanan: sota natna eneha bemi sheeno rauy lah, ma shebbikkesha — lo nittan lah, uma shebbeyadah — netaluhu mimmenna. shekkol hannoten enav bema sheeno shello — ma shemvakkesh en notnin lo, uma shebbeyado — notlin hemennu.
b: Vechen matzinu benachash hakkadmoni, shennatan enav bema sheeno rauy lo — ma shebbikkesh lo natnu lo, uma shebbeyado netaluhu mimmennu. amar hakkadosh baruch hu: ani amarti yehe melech al kol behema vechayya, veachshav "arur hu mikkol habbehema umikkol chayyat hassade".

Ani amarti yehallech bekoma zekufa, achshav — "al gechono yelech". ani amarti yehe maachalo maachal adam, achshav — "afar yochal". hu amar eherog et adam veessa et chavva, achshav — "eva ashit bencha uven haishsha uven zaracha uven zarah".

Vechen matzinu bekayin vekorach uvilam vedoeg vaachitofel vegechazi veavshalom vaadoniyyahu veuzziyyahu vehaman — shennatnu enehem bema sheeno rauy lahem. ma shebbikkeshu — lo nittan lahem, uma shebbeyadam — netaluhu mehem.
Bayyarech hitchilla baavera vechulei. mena hane mille? illema mishshum dichtiv: "betet Adonai et yerechech nofelet veet bitnech tzava" — vehachtiv: "vetzavta vitnah venafla yerechah"?

Amar abbaye: ki layet — layet techilla yarech, vahadar beten layet, umayya ki badki — ki orchayyhu badki, beten beresha vahadar yarech. biklala name ketiv: "latzbot beten velanpil yarech"! hahu demoda la kohen deveten beresha vahadar yarech, shello lehotzi laaz al mayim hammarim.
Mishna shimshon halach achar enav — lefichach nikkeru pelishtim et enav, shenneemar: "vayyochazuhu felishtim vaynakkeru et enav".

Avshalom nitgaa bisaro — lefichach nitla bisaro. ulefi shebba al eser pilagshe aviv — lefichach nittenu bo eser lonviyyot, shenneemar: "vayyasobbu asara anashim nose kele yoav". ulefi shegganav shalosh genevot: lev aviv, velev bet din, velev yisrael, shenneemar: "vaygannev avshalom et lev anshe yisrael" — lefichach nitkeu bo shelosha shevatim, shenneemar: "vayyikkach shelosha shevatim bechappo vayyitkaem belev avshalom".

Vechen leinyan hattova: miryam himtina lemoshe shaa achat, shenneemar: "vattetatztzav achoto merachok" — lefichach nitakkevu lah yisrael shiva yamim bammidbar, shenneemar: "vehaam lo nasa ad heasef miryam".
Yosef zacha likbor et aviv, veen beechav gadol mimmennu, shenneemar: "vayyaal yosef likbor et aviv vayyaalu immo gam rechev gam parashim". mi lanu gadol miyyosef, shello nitassek bo ella moshe.

Moshe zacha beatzmot yosef, veen beyisrael gadol mimmennu, shenneemar: "vayyikkach moshe et atzmot yosef immo" — mi gadol mimmoshe shello nitassek bo ella hammakom, shenneemar: "vayyikbor oto baggay". lo al moshe bilvad amru, ella al kol hatztzaddikim, shenneemar: "vehalach lefanecha tzidkecha kevod Adonai yaasfecha".

Gemara tanu rabbanan: shimshon beenav marad, shenneemar: "vayyomer shimshon el aviv otah kach li ki hi yashra veenay" — lefichach nikkeru pelishtim et enav, shenneemar: "vayyochazuhu felishtim vaynakkeru et enav".
Ini? vehachtiv: "veaviv veimmo lo yadu ki meAdonai hi". ki azal miha — batar yashruteh azal.

Tanya, rabbi omer: techillat kilkulo beazza, lefichach laka beazza. techillat kilkulo beazza, dichtiv: "vayyelech shimshon azzata vayyar sham ishsha zona vegomer", lefichach laka beazza dichtiv: "vayyoridu oto azzatah".
Vehachtiv: "vayyered shimshon timnata"? techillat kilkulo miha beazza hava.

"Vayhi achare chen vayyeehav ishsha benachal sorek ushemah delila". tanya, rabbi omer: ilmale lo nikra shemah "delila" — reuya hayta shettikkare delila: dildela et kocho, dildela et libbo, dildela et maasav.

Dildela et kocho — dichtiv: "vayyasar kocho mealav". dildela et libbo — dichtiv: "vattere delila ki higgid lah et kol libbo". dildela et maasav — deistallak shechina minneh, dichtiv: "vehu lo yada ki Adonai sar mealav".

"Vattere delila ki higgid lah et kol libbo". mena yada? amar rabbi chanin amar rav: nikkarin divre emet. abbaye amar: yada bo beoto tzaddik dela mappek shem shamayim levattala. kevan daamar "nezir elohim ani", amara: hasheta vadday kusheta kaamar.
"Vayhi ki hetzika lo vidvareha kol hayyamim vattealtzehu". may "vattealtzehu"? amar rabbi yitzchak deve rabbi amme: bishat gemar bia nishmeta mittachtav.
"Veatta hishshamri na veal tishti yayin veshechar veal tochli kol tame". may "kol tame"? vetu: ad hasheta devarim temeim kaachla?! amar rabbi yitzchak deve rabbi amme: devarim haasurim benazir.
"Vayyivka elohim et hammachtesh asher ballechi". amar rabbi yitzchak deve rabbi amme: hu ivva ledavar tame — lefichach nitlu chayyav bedavar tame.
"Vattachel ruach Adonai vegomer". amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: chalta nevuato shel yaakov avinu, dichtiv: "yehi dan nachash ale derech".
"Lefaamo bemachane dan", amar rabbi yitzchak deve rabbi amme: melammed shehayta shechina mekashkeshet lefanav kezog. ketiv hacha: "lefaamo bemachane dan", uchetiv hatam: "paamon verimmon".
"Ben tzora uven eshtaol", amar rabbi assi: tzora veeshtaol shene harim gedolim hayu, vaakaran shimshon utechanan ze baze.
"Vehu yachel lehoshia et yisrael", amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina:

a: Huchal shevuato shel avimelech, dichtiv: "im tishkor li ulenini ulenechdi".
"Vayyigdal hannaar vayvarchehu Adonai". bamme bercho? amar rav yehuda amar rav, shebbercho beammato: ammato kivne adam, vezaro kenachal shotef.

"Vayyikra shimshon el Adonai vayyomer Adonai elohim zochreni na vechazzekeni na ach happaam hazze veinnakma nekam achat mishshete enay mippelishtim". amar rav: amar shimshon lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, zechor li esrim ushetayim shana sheshshafatti et yisrael, velo amarti leechad mehem haaver li makkel mimmakom lemakom.

"Vayyelech shimshon vayyilkod shelosh meot shualim". may shena shualim? amar rabbi ayyevu bar nagdi amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba: amar shimshon, yavo mi shechozer laachorav, veyippara mippelishtim shechazru bishvuatan.

Tanya, amar rabbi shimon hechasid: ben ketefav shel shimshon shishshim amma haya, shenneemar: "vayyishkav shimshon ad chatzi hallayla vayyakom bachatzi hallayla vayyeechoz bedaltot shaar hair uvishte hammezuzot vayyissaem im habberiach vayyasem al ketefav", ugemiri deen daltot azza pechutot mishshishshim amma.

"Vayhi tochen bevet haasurim". amar rabbi yochanan: en techina ella leshon avera, vechen hu omer: "titchan leacher ishti". melammed shekkol echad veechad hevi lo et ishto levet haasurim kede shettitabber hemennu. amar rav pappa: hayeynu deamri inashe: kamme deshate chamra — chamra, kamme rafoka (geridya — duvela).

Veamar rabbi yochanan: kol hamezanne — ishto (mezannenet) [mezanna] alav, shenneemar: "im nifta libbi al ishsha veal petach rei aravti", uchetiv: "titchan leacher ishti vealeha yichreun acherin", vehayeynu deamri inashe: ihu be kare, veitteteh be vutzine.

Veamar rabbi yochanan: shimshon dan et yisrael kaavihem shebbashshamayim, shenneemar: "dan yadin ammo keachad vegomer". veamar rabbi yochanan: shimshon al shemo shel hakkadosh baruch hu nikra, shenneemar: "ki shemesh umagen Adonai elohim vegomer". ella meatta, lo yimmache! ella: meen shemo shel hakkadosh baruch hu: ma hakkadosh baruch hu megen al kol haolam kullo — af shimshon megen bedoro al yisrael.
Veamar rabbi yochanan: bilam chigger beraglo achat haya, shenneemar "vayyelech shefi". shimshon chigger bishte raglav haya, shenneemar: "shefifon ale orach".
Tanu rabbanan: chamishsha nivreu meen dugema shel mala, vechullan laku bahen. shimshon bechocho, shaul betzavvaro, avshalom bisaro, tzidkiyya beenav, asa beraglav.
Shimshon bechocho, dichtiv: "vayyasar kocho mealav".
Shaul betzavvaro, dichtiv: "vayyikkach shaul et hacherev vayyippol aleha".
Avshalom bisaro, kidvaenan lememar kamman. tzidkiyya beenav, dichtiv: "veet ene tzidkiyyahu ivver".

Asa beraglav, dichtiv: "rak leet ziknato chala et raglav", veamar rav yehuda amar rav: sheachazattu padagra. amar leh mar zutera bereh derav nachman lerav nachman: hechi dame padagra? amar leh: kemachat bivsar hachay. mena yada? ikka deamri: mechash hava chash beh. veikka deamri: merabbeh shema leh. veikka deamri: "sod Adonai lireav uverito lehodiam".

Daresh rava: mippene ma neenash asa — mippene sheasa angarya betalmide chachamim, shenneemar: "vehammelech asa hishmia et kol yehuda en naki". may "en naki"? amar rav yehuda amar rav: afillu chatan mechedro vechalla mechuppatah.
Ketiv: "vayyered shimshon timnata", uchetiv: "hinne chamich ole timnata". amar rabbi elazar: shimshon shennitganna bah — ketiv beh yerida. yehuda shennitalla bah — ketiv beh aliyya.
Rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: shete timnaot hayu, chada birida, vachada baaliyya.
Rav pappa amar: chada timna havay, deate mehay gisa — yerida, udeate mehay gisa — aliyya. kegon vardonya uve vare veshuka denaresh.

"Vatteshev befetach enayim". amar rabbi alekkesanderi: melammed shehalcha veyashva lah befitcho shel avraham avinu, makom shekkol enayim tzofot liroto. rabbi chanin amar rav: makom hu sheshshemo enayim, vechen hu omer: "tappuach vehaenam".

Rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: shennatna enayim lidvareha. keshettevaah amar lah: shemma nochrit at? amra leh: giyyoret ani. shemma eshet ish at? amra leh: penuya ani. shemma kibbel bich avicha kiddushin? amra leh: yetoma ani. shemma temea at? amra leh: tehora ani.
"Vayyitta eshel biver shava", amar resh lakish: melammed sheasa pardes, venata bo kol mine megadim.

Rabbi yehuda verabbi nechemya, chad amar: pardes, vechad amar: punedak. bishlama leman deamar pardes, hayeynu dichtiv "vayyitta". ella leman deamar punedak, may "vayyitta"? kedichtiv: "vayyitta ohole appadno vegomer".
"Vayyikra sham beshem Adonai el olam". amar resh lakish: al tikre "vayyikra",
b: Ella "vayyakri". melammed shehikri avraham avinu lishmo shel hakkadosh baruch hu befe kol over vashav. ketzad? leachar sheachlu veshatu, amdu levarcho. amar lahem: vechi mishshelli achaltem? mishshel elohe olam achaltem! hodu veshabbechu uvarchu lemi sheamar vehaya haolam.
"Vayyireha yehuda vayyachsheveha lezona ki chisseta paneha". mishshum dechisseta paneha, chashsheva lezona?!

Amar rabbi elazar: shekkisseta paneha bevet chamiha. deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: kol kalla shehi tzenua bevet chamiha — zocha veyotzin mimmenna melachim uneviim. menalan — mittamar. neviim — dichtiv: "chazon yeshayahu ven amotz". melachim — middavid. veamar rabbi levi: davar ze masoret beyadenu meavotenu: amotz vaamatzya — achim havo.
"Hi mutzet". "hi mittotzet" mibbee leh! amar rabbi elazar: leachar shennimtzeu simaneha ba sammael verichakan, ba gavriel vekervan.

Hayeynu dichtiv: "limnatztzeach al yonat elem rechokim ledavid michtam", amar rabbi yochanan: mishshaa shennitrachaku simaneha naaset keyona illemet. "ledavid michtam": sheyyatza mimmenna david, shehaya mach vetam lakkol. davar acher: "michtam" — shehayta makkato tamma, shennolad keshehu mahul. davar acher: "michtam" — keshem shebbekatnuto hiktin atzmo etzel mi sheggadol mimmennu lilmod tora, kach bigdullato.

"Vehi shalcha el chamiha lemor leish asher elle lo anochi hara". vetema leh memar! amar rav zutera bar toviyya amar rav, veamri la amar rav chana bar bizna amar rabbi shimon chasida, veamri lah amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: noach lo laadam sheyyappil atzmo letoch kivshan haesh, veal yalbin pene chavero barabbim. menalan — mittamar.
"Hakker na". amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: behakker" bisser leaviv — behakker" bisseruhu. behakker" bisser: "hakker na hakketonet bincha hi". behakker" bisseruhu: "hakker na lemi".
"Na". en "na" ella leshon bakkasha. amra leh: bevakkasha mimmecha, hakker pene boraacha veal taalim enecha mimmenni.

"Vayyakker yehuda vayyomer tzadka mimmenni". hayeynu deamar rav chanin bar bizna amar rabbi shimon chasida: yosef shekkiddesh shem shamayim basseter — zacha vehosifu lo ot achat mishshemo shel hakkadosh baruch hu, dichtiv: "edut bihosef samo".

Yehuda shekkiddesh shem shamayim befarhesya — zacha venikra kullo al shemo shel hakkadosh baruch hu. kevan shehoda veamar "tzadka mimmenni", yatzta bat kol veamra: atta hitztzalta tamar ushene baneha min haur — chayyecha sheani matztzil bizchutecha shelosha mibbanecha min haur. man ninhu — chananya mishael vaazarya.
"Tzadka mimmenni". mena yada? yatzta bat kol veamra: mimmenni yatzu kevushim.

"Velo yasaf od ledata". amar shemuel sava chamu derav shemuel bar amme mishshemeh derav shemuel bar amme: kevan sheyyedaah — shuv lo pasak mimmenna. ketiv hacha: "velo yasaf od ledata", uchetiv hatam: "kol gadol velo yasaf".

Avshalom nitgaa bisaro vechulei. tanu rabbanan: avshalom bisaro marad, shenneemar: "ucheavshalom lo haya ish yafe vegomer. uvegallecho et rosho vehaya mikketz yamim layyamim asher yegalleach ki chaved alav vegillecho veshakal et sear rosho matayim shekalim beeven hammelech". tana: even sheanshe teverya veanshe tzippori shoklim bah.

Lefichach nitla bisaro, shenneemar: "vayyikra avshalom lifne avde david veavshalom rochev al happered vayyavo happered tachat sovech haela haggedola vayyechezak rosho vaela vayyuttan ben hashshamayim uven haaretz vehappered asher tachtav avar". shekal safsira bea lemifsekeh. tana deve rabbi yishmael: beotah shaa nivka sheol mittachtav.

"Vayyirgaz hammelech vayyaal al aliyyayt hashshaar vayyevk vecho amar belechto beni avshalom beni veni avshalom mi yitten muti ani tachtecha avshalom beni veni. vehammelech laat et panav vayyizak hammelech kol gadol beni avshalom avshalom beni veni". hane temanya "beni" lema? shiva deassekeh mishshiva medore gehinnam, veiddach, ikka deamri: dekarev resheh legabbe gufeh, veikka deamri: deayyteh lealma deate.

"Veavshalom lakach vayyatztzev lo vechayyav". may "lakach"? amar resh lakish: shellakach mikkach ra leatzmo. "et matztzevet asher beemek hammelech vegomer", amar rabbi chanina bar pappa: beetza amukka shel malko shel olam,

a: Dichtiv: "hinni mekim alecha raa mibbetecha". kayyotze baddavar atta omer: "vayyishlachehu meemek chevron", amar rabbi chanina bar pappa: beetza amukka shel oto tzaddik shekkavur bechevron, dichtiv: "yadoa teda ki ger yihye zaracha".

"Ki amar en li ven". vela havo leh bene? vehachtiv: "vayyivvaldu leavshalom shelosha banim uvat achat"! amar rav yitzchak bar avdimi: shello haya lo ben hagun lammalchut. rav chisda amar, gemiri: kol hassoref tevuato shel chavero, eno manniach ben leyorsho. veihu kalyay lidyoav, dichtiv: "vayyomer el avadav reu chelkat yoav el yadi velo sham seorim lechu vehatztzituha vaesh vayyatztzitu avde avshalom et hachelka baesh".
Vechen leinyan hattova miryam vechulei. mi dame? hatam — chada shata, hacha — shiva yome! amar abbaye, ema: uleinyan hattova eno ken.
Amar leh rava: ha "vechen leinyan hattova" katane! ella amar rava, hachi katane: vechen leinyan hattova, divotah midda, uleolam midda tova merubba mimmiddat pureanut.

"Vattetatztzav achoto merachok", amar rabbi yitzchak: pasuk ze kullo al shem shechina neemar: "vattetatztzav" — dichtiv: "vayyavo Adonai vayyityatztzav vegomer". "achoto" — dichtiv: "emor lachochma achoti at". "merachok" — dichtiv: "merachok Adonai nira li". "ladaat" — dichtiv: "ki el deot Adonai". "ma" — dichtiv: "ma Adonai elohecha shoel meimmach". "yease" — dichtiv: "ki lo yaase Adonai elohim davar". "lo" — dichtiv: "vayyomer lo Adonai shalom".

"Vayyakom melech chadash vegomer". rav ushemuel, chad amar: chadash mammash, vechad amar: shennitchaddeshu gezerotav. man deamar chadash mammash — dichtiv "chadash", uman deamar shennitchaddeshu gezerotav, dela ketiv "vayyamot vayyimloch". "asher lo yada et yosef", dahava dame keman dela yada leh kelal.

"Vayyomer el ammo hinne am bene yisrael". tana: hu hitchil beetza techilla lefichach laka techilla. hu hitchil beetza techilla — dichtiv: "vayyomer el ammo", lefichach laka techilla — kedichtiv: "uvecha uveammecha uvechol avadecha".
"Hava nitchakkema lo". "lahem" mibbee leh! amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: bou venechkam lemoshian shel yisrael —
Bamme nedunem? nedunem baesh — ketiv: "ki hinne Adonai baesh yavo", uchetiv: "ki vaesh Adonai nishpat vegomer". becherev — ketiv: ["uvecharbo et kol basar"].

Ella bou unedunem bammayim, shekkevar nishba hakkadosh baruch hu sheeno mevi mabbul laolam, shenneemar: "ki me noach zot li vegomer". vehen enan yodin sheal kol haolam kullo eno mevi, aval al umma achat hu mevi.

I name: hu eno mevi, aval hen bain venoflin betocho. vechen hu omer: "umitzrayim nasim likrato". vehayeynu deamar rabbi elazar: may dichtiv "ki vaddavar asher zadu alehem" — bikdera shebbishshelu, bah nitbashshelu. may mashma dehay "zadu" lishshana dikdera hu — dichtiv: "vayyazed yaakov nazid".
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi simay: shelosha hayu beotah etza: bilam, veiyyov, veyitro.

Bilam sheyyaatz — neherag, iyyov sheshshatak — niddon beyissurin. yitro shebbarach — zachu mibbene vanav sheyyashvu belishkat haggazit, shenneemar: "umishpechot sofrim yoshve yabetz tiratim shimatim suchatim hemma hakkinim habbaim mechammat avi vet rechav", uchetiv: "uvene keni choten moshe vegomer".
"Venilcham banu veala min haaretz", "vealinu" mibbee leh! amar rabbi abba bar kahana: keadam shemmekallel et atzmo, vetole killato bachavero.

"Vayyasimu alav sare missim", "alehem" mibbee leh! tana deve rabbi elazar berabbi shimon: melammed sheheviu malben vetalu lo lefaro betzavvaro, vechol echad veechad miyyisrael sheamar lahem istenis ani, amru lo: kelum istenis atta yoter mipparo?
"Sare missim", davar shemmesim (levenim).
"Lemaan annoto besivlotam", ["annotam" mibbee leh]! lemaan annoto lefaro besivlotam deyisrael.
"Vayyiven are miskenot lefaro", rav ushemuel, chad amar: shemmesakkenot et balehen. vechad amar: shemmemaskenot et balehen, deamar mar: kol haosek bevinyan mitmasken.

"Et pitom veet raamses". rav ushemuel, chad amar: pitom shemah, velamma nikra shemah raamses — sherishon rishon mitroses. vechad amar: raamses shemah, velamma nikra shemah pitom — sherishon rishon pi tehom bolo.

"Vechaasher yeannu oto ken yirbe vechen yifrotz". "ken rabbu vechen partzu" mibbee leh! amar resh lakish: ruach hakkodesh mevassartan: "ken yirbe vechen yifrotz". "vayyakutzu mippene bene yisrael", melammed shehayu domin beenehem kekotzim.
"Vayyaavidu mitzrayim et bene yisrael
b: Befarech", rabbi elazar amar: befe rach. rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: bifricha.
"Vaymarru et chayyehem baavoda kasha bechomer uvilvenim vegomer", amar rava: battechilla "bechomer uvilvenim", ulevassof "uvechol avoda bassade".

"Et kol avodatam asher avdu vahem befarech", amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: shehayu machlifin melechet anashim lenashim umelechet nashim laanashim. uleman deamar name hatam befe rach, hacha vadday bifricha.

Daresh rav avvira: bischar nashim tzidkaniyyot shehayu beoto haddor nigalu yisrael mimmitzrayim. beshaa sheholchot lishov mayim, hakkadosh baruch hu mezammen lahem dagim ketannim bechaddehen, veshoavot mechetza mayim umechetza dagim, uvaot veshoftot shete kederot, achat shel chammin veachat shel dagim.

Umolichot etzel balehen lassade, umarchitzot otan, vesachot otan, umaachilot otan, umashkot otan, venizkakot lahen ben shefattayim, shenneemar: "im tishkevun ben shefattayim vegomer", bischar "tishkevun ben shefattayim" zachu yisrael levizzat mitzrayim, shenneemar: "kanfe yona nechpa vakkesef veevroteha birakrak charutz".
Vechevan shemmitabberot baot levattehem, vechevan shemmaggia zeman moldehen holchot veyoldot bassade tachat hattappuach, shenneemar: "tachat hattappuach orarticha vegomer".

Vehakkadosh baruch hu sholeach mishsheme marom mi shemmenakker umeshapper otan, kechayya zo shemmeshapperet et havvalad, shenneemar: "umoldotayich beyom hulledet otach lo chorat shorech uvemayim lo ruchatzt lemishi vegomer". umelakket lahen shene iggulin, echad shel shemen veechad shel devash, shenneemar: "vayyenikehu devash missela veshemen vegomer".

Vechevan shemmakkirin bahen mitzrim bain lehorgan, venaasa lahem nes venivlain bakkarka, umeviin shevavrim vechorshin al gabban, shenneemar: "al gabbi charshu chorshim vegomer". leachar sheholchin hayu mevatzbetzin veyotzin keesev hassade, shenneemar: "revava ketzemach hassade netattich".
Vechevan shemmitgaddelin bain adarim adarim levattehen, shenneemar: "vattirbi vattigdeli vattavoi baadi adayim", al tikre "baadi adayim", ella "beedre adarim".
Ucheshennigla hakkadosh baruch hu al hayyam, hem hikkiruhu techilla, shenneemar: "ze eli veanvehu".

"Vayyomer melech mitzrayim lamyalledot haivriyyot vegomer". rav ushemuel, chad amar: ishsha uvittah, vechad amar: kalla vachamotah. man deamar ishsha uvittah — yocheved umiryam, uman deamar kalla vachamotah — yocheved veelisheva.
Tanya keman deamar ishsha uvittah, detanya: shifra zo yocheved, velamma nikra shemah shifra — shemmeshapperet et havvalad. davar acher: "shifra" — shepparu veravu yisrael beyameha.
"Pua" — zo miryam. velamma nikra shemah "pua" shehayta poa umotzia et havvalad. davar acher: "pua" — shehayta poa beruach hakkodesh veomeret: atida immi shetteled ben shemmoshia et yisrael.
"Vayyomer beyalledchen et haivriyyot vegomer". may "ovnayim" — amar rabbi chanan: siman gadol masar lahen. amar lahen: beshaa shekkoraat leled yarchoteha mitztannenot kaavanim.

Veit deamar, kedichtiv: "vaered bet hayyotzer vehinne hu ose melacha al haovnayim", ma yotzer ze — yarech mikkan veyarech mikkan vesaddan baemtza, af ishsha — yarech mikkan veyarech mikkan vehavvalad baemtza.
"Im ben hu vahamitten oto". amar rabbi chanina, siman gadol masar lahen: ben panav lematta, bat paneha lemala.
"Vattirena hameyalledot et haelohim velo asu kaasher dibber alehen vegomer". "lahen" mibbee leh! amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: melammed shettevaan lidvar avera velo nitbeu.
"Vattechayyena et hayyeladim". tana: lo dayyayn shello hemitu otan, ella shehayu maspikot lahem mayim umazon.
"Vattomarna hameyalledot el paro ki lo channashim vegomer". may "chayot"? ilema chayyot mammash, attu chayya mi la tzericha chayya achariti leoloda?
Ella amru lo, umma zo kechayya nimshela: yehuda — "gur arye", dan — "yehi dan nachash", "naftali ayyala shelucha", "yissashchar chamor garem", yosef — "bechor shor", "binyamin zeev yitraf".
Dichtiv beh — ketiv beh. udela ketiv beh — ketiv beh: "ma immecha leviyya ben arayot ravatza vegomer".

"Vayhi ki yaru hameyalledot et haelohim vayyaas lahem battim". rav ushemuel, chad amar: batte chehunna uleviyya, vechad amar: batte malchut. man deamar batte chehunna uleviyya — aharon umoshe. uman deamar batte malchut — david name mimmiryam kaate, dichtiv: "vattamot azuva eshet kalev vayyikkach lo chalev et efrat vatteled lo et chur". uchetiv: "vedavid ben ish efrati vegomer".
"Vechalev ben chetzron holid et azuva ishsha veet yeriot veelle vaneha yesher veshovav veardon". ben chetzron? ben yefunne hu! ben sheppana meatzat meraggelim.
Veakkatti: ben kenaz hu, dichtiv: "vayyilkedah otniel ben kenaz achi chalev"! amar rava: chorgo diknaz hava.

a: Dayka name dichtiv "hakkenizzi". shema minna.

"Azuva" — zo miryam, velamma nikra shemah azuva — shehakkol azavuha mittechillatah. "holid" — vahalo minsav hava nasev la! amar rabbi yochanan: kol hannose ishsha leshem shamayim — maale alav hakkatuv keillu yeladah.
"Yeriot" — shehayu paneha domin liriot.
"Veelle baneha" — al tikre baneha ella "boneha", "yesher" — sheyyishsher et atzmo. "shovav" — sheshshibbev et yitzro, "veardon" — sherada et yitzro, veikka deamri: al shehayu paneha domin levered.

"Uleashchur avi tekoa hayu shete nashim chela venaara". "ashchur" — ze kalev, velamma nikra shemo "ashchur" — shehushecharu panav betaaniyyot. "avi" — shennaasa lah keav, "tekoa" — shettaka et libbo leaviv shebbashshamayim.
"Hayu shete nashim" — naasa miryam kishte nashim. "chela venaara" — la chela venaara havay, ella battechilla chela, ulevassof naara.
"Uvene chela tzeret vetzohar veetnan". "tzeret" — shennaaset tzara lechavroteha. "tzohar" — shehayu paneha domin katztzohorayim, "etnan" — shekkol haroe otah molich etnan leishto.

"Vaytzav paro lechol ammo", amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: af al ammo gazar. veamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: shalosh gezerot gazar: battechilla "im ben hu vahamitten oto", ulevassof "kol habben hayyillod hayeora tashlichuhu", ulevassof af al ammo gazar.
"Vayyelech ish mibbet levi". lehechan halach? amar rav yehuda bar zevina: shehalach baatzat bitto.
Tana: amram gedol haddor haya. kevan sheraa sheamar paro harasha "kol habben hayyillod hayeora tashlichuhu", amar: lashshav anu amelin, amad vegerash et ishto. amdu kullan vegershu et neshotehen.

Amra lo bitto: abba, kasha gezeratcha yoter mishshel paro. shepparo lo gazar ella al hazzecharim, veatta gazarta al hazzecharim veal hannekevot. paro la gazar ella baolam hazze, veatta baolam hazze uleolam habba.

Paro harasha — safek mitkayyemet gezerato, safek enah mitkayyemet. atta tzaddik, bevadday sheggezeratcha mitkayyemet, shenneemar: "vetigzar omer veyakom lach". amad vehechzir et ishto, amdu kullan vehechziru et neshotehen.

"Vayyikkach". "vayyachzir" mibbee leh! amar rav yehuda bar zevina: sheasa lo maase likkuchin — hoshivah beappiryon, veaharon umiryam merakkedin lefaneha, umalache hashsharet amru "em habbanim semecha".

"Et bat levi". efshar bat mea usheloshim shana havya vekare la "bat", deamar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: zo yocheved, shehoratah badderech veledatah ben hachomot, shenneemar: "asher yalda otah lelevi bemitzrayim" —
Ledatah bemitzrayim, veen horata bemitzrayim. amar rabbi yehuda: shennoldu bah simane naarut.

"Vattahar haishsha vatteled ben". veha havat miabbera beh telata yarche meikkara! amar rav yehuda bar zevina: makkish ledatah lehoratah: ma horatah shello betzaar — af ledatah shello betzaar. mikkan lenashim tzidkaniyyot shello hayu befitkah shel chavva.

"Vattere oto ki tov hu". tanya, rabbi meir omer: "tov" shemo. rabbi yehuda omer: "toviyya" shemo. rabbi nechemya omer: hagun linviut. acherim omrim: nolad keshehu mahul. vachachamim omrim: beshaa shennolad moshe, nitmalle habbayit kullo or. ketiv hacha: "vattere oto ki tov hu", uchetiv hatam: "vayyar elohim et haor ki tov".
"Vattitzpenehu shelosha yerachim" — dela meno mitzriyyim ella mishshaa deahdera, vehi havat miabbera beh telata yarche meikkara.

"Velo yachla od hatztzefino". ammay? titzpeneh vetezil! ella, kol hecha dahavo shami mitzrae demityelid yanoka, mamtu yanoke hatam ki hechi delishmeinhu umeavve bahadayhu, dichtiv: "echezu lanu shualim shualim ketannim vegomer".
"Vattikkach lo tevat gome". may shena gome? amar rabbi elazar: mikkan letzaddikim shemmamonam chaviv alehen yoter miggufan. vechol kach lamma — lefi sheen poshtin yedehen begazel.
Rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: davar rach, sheyyachol laamod bifne davar rach uvifne davar kashe.
"Vattachmera vachemar uvazzafet", tana: chemar mibbifnim vezefet mibbachutz, kede shello yariach oto tzaddik reach ra.
"Vattasem bah et hayyeled vattasem bassuf", rabbi elazar omer: yam suf. rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar:
b: Agam, kedichtiv: "kane vasuf kamelu".

"Vattered bat paro lirchotz al hayeor", amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: melammed sheyyarda lirchotz miggillule [bet] aviha, vechen hu omer: "im rachatz Adonai et tzoat benot tziyyon vegomer".
"Venaaroteha holchot vegomer", amar rabbi yochanan: en halicha zo ella leshon mita, vechen hu omer: "hinne anochi holech lamut".

"Vattere et hatteva betoch hassuf", kevan dachazo deka vau leatztzole lemoshe, amru lah: gevirtenu, minhago shel olam melech basar vadam gozer gezera, im kol haolam kullo en mekayyeymin otah — banav uvene veto mekayyeymin otah, veat overet al gezerat avich? ba gavriel vachavatan bakkarka.
"Vattishlach et amatah vattikkacheha". rabbi yehuda verabbi nechemya, chad amar: yadah, vechad amar: shifchatah. man deamar yadah — dichtiv "ammatah". uman deamar shifchatah — middela ketiv "yadah".
Uleman deamar shifchatah, ha amrat ba gavriel vachavatan bakkarka! deshayyayr la chada, delav orcha devat malka lemekam lechoda.

Uleman deamar yadah, lichtov "yadah"! ha ka mashma lan deishtarbav ishtarbove. deamar mar: vechen atta motze beammatah shel bat paro, vechen atta motze beshinne reshaim, dichtiv: "shinne reshaim shibbarta", veamar resh lakish: al tikre "shibbarta", ella "sheribbavta".
"Vattiftach vattirehu et hayyeled". "vattere" mibbee leh! amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: sheraata shechina immo.

"Vehinne naar boche". kare leh "yeled", vekare leh "naar". tana: hu yeled vekolo kenaar, divre rabbi yehuda. amar lo rabbi nechemya: im ken, asito lemoshe rabbenu baal mum. ella, melammed sheasta lo immo chuppat neurim batteva, amra: shemma lo ezke lechuppato.
"Vattachmol alav vattomer miyyalde haivrim ze". mena yada? amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: sheraata oto mahul.
"Ze". amar rabbi yochanan: melammed shennitnabbea shello middatah — ze nofel, veen acher nofel.
Vehayeynu deamar rabbi elazar, may dichtiv: "vechi yomru alechem dirshu el haovot veel hayyiddeonim hametzaftzefim vehammahgim": tzofin veenam yodin ma tzofin, mehaggim veenan yodim ma mehaggim.

Rau shemmoshian shel yisrael bammayim hu loke, amdu vegazru: "kol habben hayyillod hayeora tashlichuhu". kevan deshadyu lemoshe, amru: tu la chazenan ki hahu simana, battilu ligzertayyhu. vehem enan yodin sheal me meriva hu loke.

Vehayeynu deamar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: may dichtiv "hemma me meriva asher ravu" — hemma sherau itztagnine paro vetau. vehayeynu dekaamar moshe: "shesh meot elef ragli vegomer", amar lahen moshe leyisrael: bishvili nitztzaltem kullechem.
Rabbi chanina bar pappa amar: oto hayyom esrim veechad benisan haya, amru malache hashsharet lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, mi sheatid lomar shira al hayyam beyom ze — yilke beyom ze?
Rabbi acha bar chanina amar: oto hayyom shishsha besivan haya, amru malache hashsharet lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, mi sheatid lekabbel tora mehar sinay beyom ze — yilke beyom ze?

Bishlama leman deamar beshishsha besivan, mashkachat la telata yarche. deamar mar: beshiva baadar met, uveshiva baadar nolad moshe, umishshiva baadar vead shishsha besivan telata yarche. ella leman deamar beesrim veechad benisan, hechi mashkachat la?
Otah shana meubberet hayta: rubbo shel rishon, verubbo shel acharon, veemtzai shalem.
"Vattomer achoto el bat paro haelech vekarati lach ishsha meneket min haivriyyot". umay shena meivriyyot?

Melammed shehechziruhu lemoshe al kol hammitzriyyot kullan, velo yanak, amar: pe sheatid ledabber im hashshechina yinak davar tame? vehayeynu dichtiv: "et mi yore dea vegomer". lemi yore dea ulemi yavin shemua — "ligmule mechalav uleattike mishshadayim".
"Vattomer lah bat paro lechi vegomer". amar rabbi elazar: melammed shehalcha bizrizut kealma. rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: "haalma" — sheheelima et devareha.

"Vattomer lah bat paro helichi et hayyeled hazze". amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: mitnabbea veenah yodaat ma mitnabbea, "helichi" — ha shellichi. "vaani etten et secharech". amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: lo dayyayn latztzaddikim shemmachzirin lahen avedatan, ella shennotnin lahen secharan.
"Vattikkach miryam hannevia achot aharon vegomer". achot aharon velo achot moshe? amar rav amram amar rav, veamri la, amar rav nachman amar rav: melammed shehayta mitnabbea keshehi achot aharon,

a: Veomeret: atida immi shetteled ben shemmoshia et yisrael. vechevan shennolad moshe nitmalle kol habbayit kullo or. amad aviha uneshakah al roshah, amar lah: bitti, nitkayyeyma nevuatich. vechevan shehittiluhu layor, amad aviha utefachah al roshah, amar lah: bitti hechan nevuatich? vehayeynu dichtiv: "vattetatztzav achoto merachok ledea ma yease lo" — leda ma yehe besof nevuatah.

Yosef zacha vechulei. may shena meikkara dichtiv: "vayyaal yosef likbor et aviv vayyaalu itto kol avde paro vegomer", vahadar: "vechol bet yosef veechav uvet aviv", umay shena levassof dichtiv: "vayyashov yosef mitzrayma hu veechav", vahadar: "vechol haolim itto likbor et aviv"?
Amar rabbi yochanan: battechilla ad shello rau bichvodan shel yisrael — lo nahagu bahen kavod, ulevassof sherau bichvodan — nahagu bahen kavod.

Dichtiv: "vayyavou ad goren haatad", vechi goren yesh lo laatad? amar rabbi avahu: melammed shehikkifuhu ketarim laarono shel yaakov kegoren ze shemmakkifim lo atad, shebbau bene esav uvene yishmael uvene ketura.
Tana: kullam lammilchama bau, kevan sherau kitro shel yosef taluy baarono shel yaakov, natlu kullan kitrehen utelaum baarono shel yaakov. tana: sheloshim veshishsha ketarim nitlu baarono shel yaakov.
"Vayyispedu sham misped gadol vechaved meod". tana: afillu susim vaafillu chamorim.

(Meellu meellu) kevan shehiggiu limarat hammachpela, ata esav ka meakkev, amar lahen: "mamre kiryat haarba hi chevron", veamar rabbi yitzchak: kiryat arba — arba zugot hayu: adam vechavva, avraham vesara, yitzchak verivka, yaakov velea. ihu kavra lelea bedideh, vehay defayesh — didi hu.

Amaru leh: zabbente. amar lehu: nehi dezabbeni becheruta, peshituta mi zabbeni? amaru leh: in, dichtiv: "bekivri asher kariti li", veamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yehotzadak: en "kira" ella leshon mechira, shekken bichrakke hayyam korin limchira "kira".

Amar lehu: havu li iggarta! amaru leh: iggarta beara demitzrayim hi. uman nezil — nezil naftali dekallil ki ayyaylta, dichtiv: "naftali ayyala shelucha hannoten imre shafer", amar rabbi avahu: al tikre "imre shafer", ella "imre sefer".

Chushim bereh dedan tamman hava, veyakkiran leh udeneh. amar lehu: may hay? veamru leh: ka meakkev hay ad deate naftali meara demitzrayim. amar lehu: vead deate naftali meara demitzrayim, yehe avi abba mutal bevizzayon? shekal kulefa machyeh aresheh, natran eneh unefalu akkara deyaakov, patchinhu yaakov leeneh veachech. vehayeynu dichtiv "yismach tzaddik ki chaza nakam peamav yirchatz bedam harasha".
Beotah shaa nitkayyeyma nevuatah shel rivka, dichtiv: "lamma eshkal gam shenechem yom echad". veaf al gav demitatan lo beyom echad havay — kevuratan miha beyom echad havay.
Vei la [i]asak beh yosef, echav la havo miasseki beh? vehachtiv: "vayyisu oto vanav artza kenaan"? amru: hannichu lo, kevodo bimlachim yoter mibbehedyotot.

Mi lanu gadol miyyosef kulei. tanu rabbanan: bo uree kamma chavivot mitzvot al moshe rabbenu, shekkol yisrael kullan nitasseku babbizza, vehu nitassek bemitzvot, shenneemar: "chacham lev yikkach mitzvot vegomer".

Uminnayin haya yodea moshe rabbenu hechan yosef kavur? amru: serach bat asher nishtayyeyra meoto haddor. halach moshe etzlah, amar lah: kelum at yodaat hechan yosef kavur? amra lo: aron shel mattechet asu lo mitzrim ukevauhu benilus hannahar, kede sheyyitbarchu memav. halach moshe veamad al sefat nilus, amar lo: yosef yosef! higgia haet shennishba hakkadosh baruch hu sheani goel etchem, vehiggia hashshevua shehishbata et yisrael. im atta mare atzmecha mutav, im lav — hare anu menukkin mishshevuatecha. miyyad tzaf arono shel yosef.

Veal titma heach barzel tzaf, shehare ketiv: "vayhi haechad mappil hakkora veet habbarzel nafal el hammayim vegomer ahah adoni vehu shaul. vayyomer ish haelohim ana nafal vayyarehu et hammakom vayyiktzov etz vayyashlech shamma vayyatzef habbarzel". vahalo devarim kal vachomer: uma elisha talmido shel eliyyahu, veeliyyahu talmido shel moshe — tzaf barzel mippanav, mippene moshe rabbenu — al achat kamma vechamma.

Rabbi natan omer: bekabbarnit shel melachim haya kavur. halach moshe veamad al kabbarnit shel melachim, amar: yosef, higgia et shennishba hakkadosh baruch hu sheani goel etchem, vehiggia shevua shehishbata et yisrael. im atta mare atzmecha — mutav, veim lav — hare anu menukkin mishshevuatecha. beotah shaa nizdaza arono shel yosef, netalo moshe, vehevio etzlo.

Vechol otan shanim shehayu yisrael bammidbar, hayu shene aronot hallalu, echad shel met veechad shel shechina, mehallechin ze im ze, vehayu ovrin veshavin omrim: ma tivan shel shene aronot hallalu? amru: echad shel met veechad shel shechina. vechi ma darko shel met lehallech im shechina? amru:
b: Kiyyem ze kol ma shekkatuv baze.

Vei la asik beh moshe — yisrael la havo miaski beh? vehachtiv: "veet atzmot yosef asher heelu vene yisrael mimmitzrayim kavru vishchem"! vetu: i la iasaku beh yisrael — banav la havo miaski beh? vehachtiv: "vayyihyu livne yosef lenachala"?!
Amru: hannichu lo, kevodo bimrubbim yoter mibbemuatin. vetu amru: hannichu lo, kevodo bigdolim yoter mibbiktannim.
"Kavru bishchem". may shena bishchem? amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: mishshechem genavuhu, velishchem nachzir avedato.
Kashu kerae ahadade, ketiv: "vayyikkach moshe et atzmot yosef immo", uchetiv: "veet atzmot yosef asher heelu vene yisrael vegomer"!
Amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: kol haose davar velo gemaro, uva acher ugemaro — maale alav hakkatuv al sheggemaro keillu asao.
Rabbi elazar omer: af moridin oto miggedullato, dichtiv: "vayhi baet hahi vayyered yehuda".
Rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: af kover ishto uvanav, dichtiv: "vattamot bat shua eshet yehuda vegomer", uchetiv: "vayyamot er veonan".
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: mippene ma nikra yosef atzamot bechayyav — mippene shello micha bichvod aviv, dekaamri leh "avdecha avinu", vela amar lehu vela midde.
Veamar rav yehuda amar rav, veittema rabbi chama berabbi chanina: mippene ma met yosef kodem leechav — mippene shehinhig atzmo berabbanut.
"Veyosef hurad mitzrayma". amar rabbi elazar: al tikre "hurad" ella "horid", shehorid itztagnine paro miggedullatan.
"Vayyiknehu potifar seris paro", amar rav: shekkenao leatzmo. ba (gavriel) [michael] veserso, ba gavriel ufero. meikkara ketiv "potifar", ulevassof "potifera".
