Mi lanu gadol mimmoshe vechulei. "vayyomer Adonai elay rav lach", amar rabbi levi: berav" bisser, berav" bisseruhu. berav" bisser — "rav lachem". berav" bisseruhu — "rav lach".
Davar acher: "rav lach" — rav yesh lecha, umannu — yehoshua.
Davar acher: "rav lach", shello yomru: harav kamma kashe, vetalmid kamma sarvan. vechol kach lamma? tana deve rabbi yishmael: lefum gamla shichna.

"Vayyomer alehem ben mea veesrim shana anochi hayyom", sheen talmud lomar "hayyom": hayyom malu yamay ushenotay. lelammedcha shehakkadosh baruch hu mashlim shenotehem shel tzaddikim miyyom leyom umechodesh lechodesh, dichtiv: "et mispar yamecha amalle".

"Lo uchal od latzet velavo". may "latzet velavo"? ilema latzet velavo mammash, vehachtiv: "umoshe ben mea veesrim shana bemoto lo nas lecho", uchetiv: "vayyaal moshe mearvot moav el har nevo", vetanya: shetem esre maalot hayu sham, ufesaan moshe bifsia achat.
Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: latzet velavo bedivre tora. melammed shennistattemu mimmennu shaare chochma.
"Vayyelech moshe vihoshua vayyityatztzevu beohel moed". tana: otah shabbat shel deyo zuge hayta, nittela reshut mizze, venittena laze.

Vetanya, amar rabbi yehuda: ilmale mikra katuv, i efshar leomro. hechan moshe met — bechelko shel reuven, dichtiv: "vayyaal moshe mearvot moav el har nevo", unevo bechelko shel reuven kayyma, dichtiv: "uvene reuven banu vegomer veet nevo vegomer".
"Nevo" — sheshsham metu shelosha neviim: moshe veaharon umiryam.
Vehechan moshe kavur — bechelko shel gad, dichtiv: "vayyar reshit lo vegomer". umechelko shel reuven ad chelko shel gad kamma have — arbaa milin. otan arbaa milin mi holicho?

Melammed shehaya moshe muttal bechanfe shechina, umalache hashsharet omrim: "tzidkat Adonai asa umishpatav im yisrael", vehakkadosh baruch hu omer: "mi yakum li im mereim mi yityatztzev li im poale aven".

Ushemuel amar: "mi kehechacham umi yodea pesher davar", verabbi yochanan amar: "hachochma meayin timmatze", verav nachman amar: "vayyamot sham moshe vegomer", semalyon amar: "vayyamot sham moshe safra rabba deyisrael".

Tanya, rabbi eliezer haggadol omer: shenem asar mil al shenem asar mil, keneged machane yisrael, bat kol mashmia veomer: "vayyamot moshe safra rabba deyisrael". veyesh omrim: lo met moshe, ketiv hacha: "vayyamot sham", uchetiv hatam: "vayhi sham im Adonai", ma lehallan omed umeshammesh, af kan omed umeshammesh.
"Vayyikbor oto vaggay beeretz moav mul bet peor". amar rabbi berechya: siman betoch siman, vaafillu hachi: "velo yada ish et kevurato".
Uchevar shalcha malchut harshaa etzel

a: Gastera shel bet peor: hareenu hechan moshe kavur. amdu lemala — nidma lahem lematta, lematta — nidma lahem lemala. nechleku lishte chittot, otan sheomdim lemala — nidma lahen lematta, lematta — nidma lahen lemala, lekayyem ma shenneemar "velo yada ish et kevurato".

Rabbi chama berabbi chanina amar: af moshe rabbenu eno yodea hechan kavur. ketiv hacha: "velo yada ish et kevurato", uchetiv hatam: "vezot habberacha asher berach moshe ish haelohim". veamar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: mippene ma nikbar moshe etzel bet peor — kede lechapper al maase feor.
Veamar rabbi chama berabbi chanina, may dichtiv: "achare Adonai elohechem telechu", vechi efshar lo leadam lehallech achar shechina? vahalo kevar neemar "ki Adonai elohecha esh ochla hu"!

Ella, lehallech achar middotav shel hakkadosh baruch hu: ma hu malbish arummim, dichtiv: "vayyaas Adonai elohim leadam uleishto kotnot or vayyalbishem" — af atta halebesh arummim. hakkadosh baruch hu bikker cholim, dichtiv: "vayyera elav Adonai beelone mamre" — af atta bakker cholim. hakkadosh baruch hu nichem avelim, dichtiv: "vayhi achare mot avraham vayvarech elohim et yitzchak beno" — af atta nachem avelim. hakkadosh baruch hu kavar metim, dichtiv: "vayyikbor oto baggay" — af atta kevor metim.
"Kotnot or". rav ushemuel, chad amar: davar habba min haor, vechad amar: davar shehaor nehene mimmennu.

Darash rabbi simlay: tora techillatah gemilut chasadim, vesofah gemilut chasadim. techillatah gemilut chasadim — dichtiv: "vayyaas Adonai elohim leadam uleishto kotnot or vayyalbishem", vesofah gemilut chasadim — dichtiv: "vayyikbor oto baggay".

Darash rabbi simlay: mippene ma nitavva moshe rabbenu likkanes leeretz yisrael? vechi leechol mippiryah hu tzarich?! o lisboa mittuvah hu tzarich?! ella kach amar moshe: harebe mitzvot nitztauu yisrael, veen mitkayyeymin ella beeretz yisrael. ekkanes ani laaretz kede sheyyitkayyeymu kullan al yadi.

Amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu: kelum atta mevakkesh ella lekabbel sachar? maale ani alecha keillu asitam, shenneemar: "lachen achallek lo varabbim veet atzumim yechallek shalal tachat asher heera lammavet nafsho veet poshim nimna vehu chet rabbim nasa velapposhim yafgia".

"Lachen achallek lo barabbim". yachol kaacharonim velo karishonim, talmud lomar: "veet atzumim yechallek shalal", keavraham yitzchak veyaakov, shehen atzumim battora uvemitzvot. "tachat asher heera lammavet nafsho", shemmasar atzmo lemita, shenneemar: "veim ayin mecheni na vegomer".

"Veet poshim nimna" — shennimna im mete midbar. "vehu chet rabbim nasa" — shekkipper al maase haegel. "velapposhim yafgia" — shebbikkesh rachamim al poshe yisrael sheyyachzeru bitshuva. veen pegia ella tefilla, shenneemar: "veatta al titpallel bead haam hazze veal tissa vaadam rinna utefilla veal tifga bi".
Hadaran alach hamekanne leishto
Haya mevi et minchatah betoch kefifa mitzrit venotnah al yadeha kede leyaggeah.
Kol hammenachot techillatan vesofan bichli sharet, vezo techillatah bichfifa mitzrit, vesofah bichli sharet.

Kol hammenachot teunot shemen ulevona, vezo enah teuna lo shemen velo levona. kol hammenachot baot min hachittin, vezo baa min hasseorin. minchat haomer, af al pi shebbaa min hasseorin — hi hayta baa geres, vezo baa kemach. rabban gamliel omer: keshem shemmaaseha maase behema, kach korbanah maachal behema.
Gemara tanya, abba chanin omer mishshum rabbi eliezer: [vechol kach lamma —] kede leyaggeah, kede shettachazor bah. im kacha chasa tora al ovre retzono, kal vachomer al ose retzono.
Umimmay mishshum dechasa hu? dilma ki hechi delo timmachek megilla! kasavar
b: Mashkah, veachar kach makriv et minchatah. dei mishshum megilla ha immechika la.

Kol hammenachot vechulei. ureminhu: seder menachot, ketzad? adam mevi mincha mittoch beto biklatot shel kesef veshel zahav, venotnah letoch keli sharet, umekaddeshah bichli sharet, venoten aleha shamnah ulevonatah, umolichah etzel kohen. vechohen molichah etzel mizbeach, umaggishah bekeren deromit maaravit keneged chuddah shel keren, vedayyo.

Umesallek et hallevona letzad echad, vekometz mimmakom shennitrabba shamnah venotno letoch keli sharet, umekaddesho bichli sharet. umelakket et levonatah venotnah al gabbav, umaale oto legabbe mizbeach, umaalehu umaktiro bichli sharet, umolcho, venotno al gabbe haishshim.
Karav hakkometz sheyareha neechalin, verashshain hakkohanim litten letochah yayin veshemen udevash, veen asurin ella millechammetz.
Katane miha biklatot shel kesef uviklatot shel zahav! amar rav pappa: ema bechelim haruyin lichle sharet.
Mikkelal dichfifa mitzrit la chazya, keman — dela kerabbi yose berabbi yehuda, detanya: kele sharet sheasaan shel etz, rabbi posel verabbi yose berabbi yehuda machshir.
Afillu tema rabbi yose berabbi yehuda, emar deamar rabbi yose berabbi yehuda bachashuvin, bifchutin mi amar? let leh lerabbi yose berabbi yehuda "hakerivehu na lefechatecha"?!
Venotnah lichle sharet, umekaddeshah bichli sharet. shamat minna — keli sharet en mekaddeshin ella middaat? ema: notnah bichli sharet lekaddeshah bichli sharet.
Venoten aleha shamnah ulevonatah, shenneemar: "veyatzak aleha shemen venatan aleha levona".
Umolichah etzel kohen, dichtiv: "veheviah el bene aharon vegomer".
Vechohen molichah etzel mizbeach, dichtiv: "vehiggishah etzel hammizbeach".
Maggishah bekeren deromit maaravit keneged chuddah shel keren vedayyo. menalan —

Dichtiv: "vezot torat hammincha hakerev otah bene aharon lifne Adonai el pene hammizbeach", vetanya: "lifne Adonai", yachol bammaarav — talmud lomar: "el pene hammizbeach". i el pene hammizbeach, yachol baddarom — talmud lomar: "lifne Adonai". ha ketzad — maggishah bekeren deromit maaravit keneged chuddah shel keren, vedayyo.

Rabbi elazar omer: yachol yaggishenna bemaaravah shel keren o lidromah shel keren — amarta: kol makom sheatta motze shene mikraot, echad mekayyem atzmo umekayyem divre chavero, veechad mekayyem atzmo umevattel divre chavero — mannichin et shemmekayyem atzmo umevattel chavero, vetofsin et shemmekayyem atzmo umekayyem chavero. kesheatta omer "lifne Adonai" bammaarav — bittalta "el pene hammizbeach" baddarom, uchesheatta omer "el pene hammizbeach" baddarom, kiyyaymta "lifne Adonai" bammaarav. ha ketzad? maggishah lidromah shel keren.
Vehechan kiyyaymta? amar rav ashe: kasavar hay tanna kulleh mizbeach betzafon kae.
May "vedayyo"? amar rav ashe: itzterich, salka datach amena: tibbee haggashat mincha gufa, kamashma lan.
Veema hachi name? amar kera: "vehikrivah el hakkohen vegomer vehiggishah el hammizbeach" — ma hakerava etzel kohen bichli, af haggasha etzel mizbeach bichli.
Umesallek et levonatah letzad echad. ki hechi dela tikkemotz bahade mincha, keditnan: kamatz veala beyado tzeror o garger melach o koret levona — pasul.
Vekometz mimmakom shennitrabba shamnah. menalan? dichtiv "missoltah umishshamnah", "miggirsah umishshamnah".

Venotno letoch keli sharet umekaddesho bichli sharet. lema li? ha kaddesha chada zimna! midde dehave addam; dam, af al gav dekaddeshteh sakkin betzavvar behema, hadar mekaddesh leh bichli sharet, hacha name la shena.
Umelakket et levonatah venotnah al gabbav — dichtiv: "veet kol hallevona asher al hammincha".
Umaalehu

a: Umaktiro bichli sharet. bichli sharet makter leh? ella ema: maalehu bichli sharet lehaketiro.
Umolcho venotno al gabbe haishshim, dichtiv: "vechol korban minchatcha bammelach timlach vegomer".
Karav hakkometz sheyareha neechalin. menalan — dichtiv: "vehiktir hakkohen et azkaratah vegomer", uchetiv: "vehannoteret min hammincha leaharon ulevanav".

Karav hakkometz. lemar kidit leh ulemar kidit leh. deittemar: hakkometz, meematay mattir shirayim baachila? rabbi chanina amar: mishshettishlot bo haur, rabbi yochanan amar: mishshettitztzat haur berubbo.
Verashshain hakkohanim litten letocho yayin veshemen udevash. may tama? amar kera: "lemoshcha" — ligdulla, kederech shehammelachim ochlin.
Veen asurin ella millechammetz, dichtiv: "lo teafe chametz chelkam", amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: afillu chelkam lo teafe chametz.
Kol hammenachot kulei. vechol hammenachot teunot shemen ulevona? vehaikka minchat chote, derachamana amar: "lo yasim aleha shemen velo yitten aleha levona"!

Hachi kaamar: kol hammenachot teunot shemen ulevona, uvaot min hachittin, uvaot solet. minchat chote, af al pi sheenah teuna shemen ulevona — baa min hachittin uvaa solet. minchat haomer, af al pi shehi baa min hasseorin — teuna shemen ulevona uvaa geres. vezo, enah teuna lo shemen velo levona, uvaa min hasseorin, uvaa kemach.
Tanya, amar rabbi shimon: bedin hu shettehe minchat chote teuna shemen ulevona, shello yehe chote niskar. umippene ma enah teuna — shello yehe korbano mehuddar.
Uvedin hu shettehe chattat chelev teuna nesachim, shello yehe chote niskar. umippene ma enah teuna — shello yehe korbano mehuddar.

Aval chattato shel metzora vaashamo teunin nesachim, lefi sheen bain al chet. ini? vehaamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: al shiva devarim negaim bain vechulei! hatam minnigeh hu deikkappar leh, ki mayyte korban — leishteroye bekadashim hu deka mayyte.
Ella meatta, chattat nazir tehe teuna nesachim, lefi sheenah baa al chet! savar la kerabbi elazar hakkappar, deamar: nazir name chote hu.
Rabban gamliel omer: keshem kulei. tanya, amar lahen rabban gamliel lachachamim: sofrim, hannichu li veedreshenna kemin chomer.
b: Deshameh lerabbi meir dekaamar: hi heechilattu maadanne olam — lefichach korbanah maachal behema. amar lo: hatinach ashira, aniyya may ikka lememar! ella: keshem shemmaaseha maase vehema — kach korbanah maachal behema.
Mishna haya mevi peyali shel cheres venoten letochah chatzi log mayim min hakkiyyor. rabbi yehuda omer: reviit. keshem shemmemaet bakketav, kach memaet bammayim.

Nichnas lahechol ufana limino, umakom haya sham amma al amma, vetavla shel shayish, vetabbaat hayta kevua bah keshehu magbiah, venotel afar mittachteha, venoten kede sheyyerae al hammayim, shenneemar: "umin heafar asher yihye bekarka hammishkan yikkach hakkohen venatan el hammayim".
Gemara tana: peyali shel cheres chadasha, divre rabbi yishmael. may tama derabbi yishmael? gamar "keli" "keli" mimmetzora: ma lehallan cheres chadasha — af kan cheres chadasha.
Vehatam menalan? dichtiv: "veshachat et hatztzippor haechat el keli cheres al mayim chayyim", ma "mayim chayyim" — shello neesta bahen melacha, af "keli" — shello neesta bo melacha.
I: ma lehallan mayim chayyim, af kan mayim chayyim?!
Lerabbi yishmael hachi name. deamar rabbi yochanan: me chiyyor, rabbi yishmael omer: me mayayn hen, vachachamim omrim: mishshear memot hen.
Ikka lemifrach: ma limtzora, shekken taun etz erez veezov usheni tolaat!
Amar rabba, amar kera: "bichli cheres", keli sheamarti lecha kevar.
Amar rava: lo shanu ella shello nitakkemu panav, aval nitakkemu panav — pesulin. may tama, dumeya demayim: ma "mayim" — shello nishtannu, af "keli" — shello nishtanna.
Bae rava: nitakkemu vehechziran letoch kivshan haesh venitlabbenu, mahu? mi amrinan: kevan deiddecho iddecho, o dilma kevan dahadur hadur?
Ta shema, rabbi elazar omer: etz erez veezov usheni tolaat shehifshil bahen kuppato laachorav — pesulin. veha hatam hadri umippashti!
Hatam deikkeluf ikkelofe.
Nichnas lahechol ufana limino vechulei. may tama? deamar mar: kol pinnot sheatta pone lo yehu ella derech yamin.
Makom haya sham amma kulei. tanu rabbanan: "umin heafar asher yihye", yachol yetakken mibbachutz veyachnis.
Talmud lomar: "bekarka hammishkan". i "bekarka hammishkan", yachol yachpor bekardummot — talmud lomar: "asher yihye". ha ketzad? yesh sham — have, en sham — ten sham.
Tanya iddach: "umin heafar asher yihye vegomer" — melammed shehaya metakken mibbachutz umachnis. "bekarka hammishkan", isi ben yehuda omer: lehavi karka

a: Shilo nov vegivon uvet olamim.
Isi ben menachem omer, eno tzarich: uma betumea kalla lo chalak hakkatuv — betumeat eshet ish chamura, lo kol shekken? im ken ma talmud lomar "bekarka hammishkan" — shello yavi mittoch kuppato.
Ibbaya lehu: en sham afar, mahu sheyyitten efer? allibba devet shammay la tibbee lach, deamri: lo matzinu efer shekkaruy "afar".

Ki tibbee lach, allibba devet hillel deamri: matzinu efer shekkaruy "afar", may? af al gav deikkeri "afar", hacha "bekarka hammishkan" ketiv, o dilma hay "bekarka hammishkan" lechidisi ben yehuda ulechidisi ben menachem hu deate?
Ta shema, deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yishmael: bishlosha mekomot halacha okevet mikra.
Hattora amra beafar", vahalacha bechol davar. hattora amra betaar", vahalacha bechol davar. hattora amra "sefer", vahalacha bechol davar.
Veim ita — lichshov name hay!

Tena veshayyayr. umay shayyayr dehay shayyayr? shayyayr metzora, detanya: "vehaya bayyom hashshevii yegallach et kol searo" — kelal, "et rosho veet zekano veet gabbot enav" — perat, "veet kol searo yegalleach" — chazar vechalal. kelal uferat uchelal — i atta dan ella cheen happerat. ma perat meforash: mekom kinnus sear venire — af kol makom kinnus sear venire.
Ma rabbi — rabbi sear haraglayim. may miet — miet devet hashshechi udechulleh gufeh.
Vehilcheta: megalleach kedallaat. ditnan: ba lo lehakkif et hametzora — maavir taar al kol besaro, vekatane sefa: uvayyom hashshevii megallecho tiglachat sheniyya ketiglachat rishona.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: ki ka chashev, halacha okevet mikra, ha okevet midderabbanan hi.
Rav pappa amar: ki ka chashev halacha okevet veokeret, ha okevet umosefet hi.
Rav ashe amar: ha matnita manni — rabbi yishmael hi, dedaresh kelale uferate.
b: Kedallaat, manni — rabbi akiva hi, dedaresh ribbuye umiute. detanya: "vehaya bayyom hashshevii yegallach et kol searo" — ribba, "et rosho veet zekano veet gabbot enav" — miet, "veet kol searo yegalleach" — chazar veribba. ribba umiet veribba — ribba hakkol.
May ribba — ribba dechulleh gufeh, umay miet — miet sear shebbetoch hachotem.
May have ala? ta shema, deamar rav huna bar ashe amar rav: en sham afar — mevi rakbuvit yarak, umekaddesh.
Vela hi: rakbuvit yarak hu dahavay afar, efer la havay afar.
Kede sheyyerae al hammayim. tanu rabbanan, shelosha tzerichin sheyyerau: afar sota, veefer para, verok yevama. mishshum rabbi yishmael amru: af dam tzippor.

May tama derabbi yishmael, dichtiv: "vetaval otam bedam hatztzippor vegomer", vetanya: "bedam", yachol baddam velo bammayim — talmud lomar: "bammayim". i mayim, yachol bammayim velo baddam — talmud lomar: "baddam". ha ketzad? mevi mayim sheddam tzippor nikkar bahen, vechamma — reviit.
Verabbanan: hahu legufeh, dehachi kaamar rachamana: atbel bedam uvemayim.
Verabbi yishmael: im ken, lichtov rachamana: "vetaval bahem", "bedam uvammayim" lema li — lenikkar.
Verabbanan: i ketav rachamana "vetaval bahem", hava amena: hay lechodeh vehay lechodeh, ketav rachamana: "bedam uvammayim" — learvan.
Verabbi yishmael, learvan kera acharina ketiv: "veshachat et hatztzippor haechat vegomer".
Verabbanan: i mehahu hava amena: lishchateh samuch lemana veninketinhu livvridin, ulekabbeleh ledam bemana acharina, ka mashma lan.
Bea minneh rabbi yirmeya merabbi zera: gedola umadchet et hammayim, ketanna venidchet mippene hammayim, mahu?
Amar leh: lav amena lach la tappek nafshach levar mehilcheta, betzippor deror shiaru rabbanan. en lecha gedola shemmadchet et hammayim, veen lecha ketanna shennidchet mippene hammayim.
Tanu rabbanan: hikdim afar lammayim — pasul, verabbi shimon machshir. may tama derabbi shimon —

Dichtiv: "velakchu lattame meafar serefat hachattat", vetanya, amar rabbi shimon: vechi afar hu? vahalo efer hu! shinna hakkatuv bemashmao ladun hemennu gezera shava. neemar kan "afar", veneemar lehallan "afar". ma lehallan afar al gabbe mayim — af kan afar al gabbe mayim.
Uma kan hikdim afar lammayim — kasher, af lehallan hikdim afar lammayim — kasher.
Vehatam menalan? tere kerae ketivi. ketiv "alav", alma efer beresha, uchetiv "mayim chayyim el keli", alma mayim beresha. ha ketzad? ratza — ze noten, ratza — ze noten.
Verabbanan: "el keli" — davka, "alav" — learvan.
Veema: "alav" — davka, "el keli" — shettehe chiyyutan bichli!
Ma matzinu bechol makom machshir lemala, af kan machshir lemala.

a: Mishna ba lo lichtov et hammegilla, meeze makom hu kotev?
Mivim lo shachav ish vegomer veat ki satit tachat ishech",

Veeno kotev "vehishbia hakkohen et haishsha". vechotev: "yitten Adonai otach leala velishvua. uvau hammayim hamearrim haelle bemeayich latzbot beten velanpil yarech". veeno kotev "veamra haishsha amen amen".
Rabbi yose omer: lo haya mafsik.
Rabbi yehuda omer: kol atzmo eno kotev ella "yitten Adonai otach leala velishvua vegomer uvau hammayim hamearrim haelle bemeayich vegomer". veeno kotev "veamra haishsha amen amen".
Gemara bemay ka mippalgi? behay kera kamippalgi: "vechatav et haalot haelle hakkohen bassefer".
Rabbi meir savar: "alot" — alot mammash. "haalot" — lerabbot kelalot habbaot mechamat berachot. "elle" — lemaote kelalot shebbemishne tora. "haelle" — lemaote tzauoot vekabbalot amen.
Verabbi yose: kullehu kidkaamrat, "et" — lerabbot tzauoot vekabbalot.
Verabbi meir — ettim la daresh.

Verabbi yehuda — kullehu bemiute daresh lehu. "alot" — alot mammash. "haalot" — lemaote kelalot habbaot mechamat berachot. "elle" — lemaote kelalot shebbemishne tora. "haelle" — lemaote tzauoot vekabbalot.
Verabbi meir, may shena hay he dimrabbe beh, umay shena hay he demaet beh?
He degabbe(5 4)ribbuya — ribbuya (hi), he degabbe(5 4)miuta — miuta.
Veha let leh lerabbi meir mikkelal lav atta shomea hen?
Amar rabbi tanchum: "hinnaki" ketiv.
Daresh rabbi akiva: ish veishsha zachu — shechina benehen. lo zachu — esh ochaltan.
Amar rava: udeishsha adifa middeish, may tama — hay metzaref, vehay la metzaref.
Amar rava: mippene ma amra tora have afar lesota? zachta — yotze mimmenna ben keavraham avinu, dichtiv beh "afar vaefer", lo zachta — tachzor laafarah.
Deresh rava: bischar sheamar avraham avinu "veanochi afar vaefer", zachu banav lishte mitzvot, efer para vaafar sota.
Vehaikka name afar kissuy haddam!
Hatam hechsher mitzva ikka, hanaa lekka.
Daresh rava: bischar sheamar avraham avinu "im michut vead seroch naal", zachu banav lishte mitzvot: chut shel techelet uretzua shel tefillin.
Bishlama retzua shel tefillin, dichtiv: "verau kol amme haaretz ki shem Adonai nikra alecha", vetanya, rabbi eliezer haggadol omer: ellu tefillin shebbarosh.
Ella chut shel techelet, may hi? detanya, haya rabbi meir omer: ma nishtanna techelet mikkol mine tzivonin?

Mippene shehattechelet dome layyam, veyam dome larakia, verakia dome lechisse hakkavod — shenneemar: "vayyiru et elohe yisrael vetachat raglav kemaase livnat hassappir ucheetzem hashshamayim latohar", uchetiv: "kemare even sappir demut kisse".
Mishna eno kotev lo al halluach, velo al hanneyayr, velo al
b: Haddiftera, ella al hammegilla, shenneemar: "bassefer".
Veeno kotev lo bekomos velo bekankantom, velo bechol davar sheroshem, ella bidyo, shenneemar: "umacha", ketav sheyyachol limmachot.

Gemara amar rava: megillat sota shekketavah ballayla — pesula. may tama — atya "tora" "tora". ketiv hacha: "veasa lah hakkohen et kol hattora hazzot", uchetiv hatam: "al pi hattora asher yorucha veal hammishpat", ma mishpat bayyom — af megillat sota bayyom.
Ketavah lemafrea — pesula, dichtiv: "vechatav et haalot haelle", ki dichtiva.
Ketavah kodem shettekabbel aleha shevua — pesula, shenneemar: "vehishbia", veachar kach "vechatav".
Ketavah iggeret — pesula. "bassefer" amar rachamana.

a: Ketavah al shene dappin — pesula. "sefer" echad amar rachamana, velo shenayim ushelosha sefarim.
Katav ot achat umachak ot achat, vechatav ot achat umachak ot achat — pesula, dichtiv: "veasa lah hakkohen et kol hattora hazzot".
Bae rava: katav shete megillot lishte sotot, umechakan letoch kos echad, mahu? ketiva lishmah baenan, vehaikka, o dilma baenan name mechika lishmah?
Veim timtza lomar baenan name mechika lishmah, mechakan bishte chosot vechazar veervan, mahu? mechika lishmah baenan, vehaikka, o dilma ha lav dida ka shatya veha lav dida ka shatya?
Veim timtza lomar ha lav dida ka shatya veha lav dida ka shatya, chazar vechillekan, mahu? yesh berera, o en berera? teku.
Bae rava: hishkah besiv, mahu? bishfoferet, mahu? derech shetiyya bechach, o en derech shetiyya bechach? teku.
Bae rav ashe: nishpechu mehen venishtayyeyru mehen, mahu? teku.
Amar rabbi zera amar rav: shete shevuot haamurot bassota. lamma? achat kodem shennimchaka megilla, veachat leachar shennimchaka.
Matkef la rava: tarvayyhu kodem shennimchaka megilla ketivan? ella amar rava: achat shevua sheyyesh immah ala, veachat shevua sheen immah ala.
Hechi dame shevua sheyyesh immah ala? amar rav amram amar rav: "mashbiani alayich shello nitmet, sheim nitmet yavou bich".
Amar rava: ala lechoda kayyma ushevua lechoda kayyma! ella amar rava: "mashbiani alayich sheim nitmet yavou bich".
Amar rav ashe: ala — ikka, shevua — lekka! ella amar rav ashe: "mashbiani alayich shello nitmet, veim nitmet yavou bich".
Mishna al ma hi omeret "amen" "amen" — amen al haala, amen al hashshevua. amen meish ze, amen meish acher. amen shello satiti arusa unesua
b: Veshomeret yavam, uchenusa. amen shello nitmeti, veim nitmeti — yavou bi.
Rabbi meir omer: amen shello nitmeti, amen shello ettame.
Hakkol shavin sheen matne immah, lo al kodem shettitares velo al achar shettitgaresh.
Nistera leechad venitmet, veachar kach hechzira — lo haya matne immah.
Ze hakkelal: kol shettibbael velo hayta asura lo — lo haya matne immah.
Gemara amar rav hamenuna: shomeret yavam shezzinneta — asura livamah. mimmay — middekatane shomeret yavam uchenusa.
I amrat bishlama asira — mishshum hachi matne bahada, ella i amrat la asira — hechi matne bahada? vehatnan, ze hakkelal: kol sheillu tibbael velo tehe asura lo — lo haya matne immah!
Amri bemareva: let hilcheta kerav hamenuna.
Ella ha dekatane "shomeret yavam uchenusa" — ha manni rabbi akiva hi, deamar: en kiddushin tofsin bechayyayve lavin, umeshavve la ki erva.
Bae rabbi yirmeya: mahu sheyyatne adam al nissuin harishonim, al nissue achiv, mahu?
Ta shema, ze hakkelal: kol shettibbael velo tehe asura lo — lo haya matne immah. ha asira — hachi name dematne. shema minna.
Rabbi meir omer: amen shello nitmeti vechulei. tanya: lo kesheamar rabbi meir amen shello ettame sheim tittame mayim bodkin otah meachshav, ella: lichshettittame — mayim meararin otah uvodkin otah.
Bae rav ashe: mahu sheyyatne adam al nissuin haacharonim? hasheta miha la asira leh, o dilma zimnin dimgaresh la vahadar mahdar la?

Ta shema: hakkol shavin shello haya matne immah lo al kodem shettitares, velo al achar shettitgaresh. nistera leechad venitmet, veachar kach yachzirenna — lo haya matne. ha yachzirenna vetittame, hachi name dematne. shema minna.
Tanu rabbanan: "zot torat hakkenaot", melammed shehaishsha shota veshona.

Rabbi yehuda omer: "zot", sheen haishsha shota veshona. amar rabbi yehuda: maase veheid lefanenu nechuneya chofer shichin shehaishsha shota veshona, vekibbalnu eduto bishne anashim, aval lo beish echad.
Vachachamim omrim: en haishsha shota veshona, ben beish echad ben bishne anashim.
Vetanna kamma name, hachtiv "zot"! verabbanan batrae name, ha chetiv "torat"!
Amar rava: beish echad uvoel echad — dechulle alma la peligi deen haishsha shota veshona,

a: Dichtiv: "zot". bishne anashim ushene boalin — dechulle alma la peligi dehaishsha shota veshona, dichtiv: "torat".
Ki peligi beish echad ushene boalin, bishne anashim uvoel echad.
Tanna kamma savar: "torat" — lerabboye kullehi, "zot" — lemaote ish echad uvoel echad.
Verabbanan batrae savri: "zot" — lemaote kullehi, "torat" — lerabboye shene anashim ushene boalin.

Verabbi yehuda: "zot" — lemaote tarte, "torat" — lerabbot tarte. "zot" lemaote tarte — ish echad uvoel echad, ish echad ushene boalin, "torat" — lerabboye tarte, shene anashim uvoel echad, shene anashim ushene boalin.
Hadaran alach haya mevi

Haya notel et minchatah mittoch kefifa mitzrit, venotnah letoch keli sharet, venotnah al yadah, vechohen manniach yado mittachteha umenifah. henif vehiggish, kamatz vehiktir, vehashshear neechol lakkohanim.

Haya mashkah veachar kach makriv et minchatah. rabbi shimon omer: makriv et minchatah veachar kach haya mashkah, shenneemar: "veachar yashke et haishsha et hammayim". im hishkah veachar kach hikriv et minchatah — keshera.
Gemara amar leh rabbi elazar lerabbi yoshiyya dedareh: la tetev akkarach ad dimfarshat lah leha milleta: minnayin leminchat sota shetteuna tenufa? mena lan?! "vehenif" ketiv ba! bivalim, menalan?
Atya "yad" "yad" mishshelamim. ketiv hacha: "velakach hakkohen miyyad haishsha", uchetiv hatam: "yadav teviena".
Ma kan kohen — af lehallan kohen, uma lehallan bealim — af kan bealim. ha ketzad? manniach yado tachat yede habbealim umenif.
Henif vehiggish kamatz vechulei. haya mashkah veachar kach makriv et minchatah. ha akreva!
Hachi kaamar: seder menachot ketzad? henif vehiggish, kamatz vehiktir, vehashshear neechol lakkohanim.

Uvehashkaa gufa peligi rabbi shimon verabbanan. derabbanan savri: mashkah veachar kach makriv et minchatah, verabbi shimon savar: makriv et minchatah veachar kach mashkah, shenneemar: "veachar yashke".
Veim hishkah veachar kach hikriv et minchatah — keshera.
b: Tanu rabbanan: "vehishka" ma talmud lomar? vahalo kevar neemar "vehishkah"! sheim nimchaka megilla veomeret "eni shota" — meararin otah umashkin otah beal korchah, divre rabbi akiva.

Rabbi shimon omer: "veachar yashke" ma talmud lomar? vahalo kevar neemar "vehishkah"! ella, leachar kol maasim kullan haamurin lemala. maggid shelosha devarim meakkevin bah: ad shello karav hakkometz, vead shello nimchaka megilla, vead shello tekabbel aleha shevua.
Ad shello karav hakkometz. rabbi shimon letameh, deamar: makriv et minchatah veachar kach mashkah.
Ad shello nimchaka megilla. ella may mashke la? amar rav ashe: lo nitzrecha lesherishshumo nikkar.
Ad shello tekabbel aleha shevua. mishta hu dela shatya, ha michtav katvi la, vehaamar rava: megillat sota shekketavah kodem shettekabbel aleha shevua — lo asa velo chelum! kedi nasva.
Bemay kamippalgi? telata kerae ketivi: "vehishka" kamma, "veachar yashke", "vehishkah" batra.

Rabbanan savri: "vehishka" kamma — legufo, shemmashke veachar kach makriv et minchatah. "veachar yashke" — mibbee leh lesherishshumo nikkar. "vehishkah" batra — sheim nimchaka megilla veomeret "eni shota", meararin otah umashke otah beal korchah.

Verabbi shimon savar: "veachar yashke" — legufo, shemmakriv et minchatah veachar kach mashkah. "vehishka" kamma — sheim hishkah veachar kach hikriv et minchatah keshera. "vehishkah" batra — sheim nimchaka megilla veamra "eni shota", meararin otah umashkin otah beal korchah.
Verabbanan — bediavad la patach kera.

Vesavar rabbi akiva mashkin otah beal korchah? vehatanya, rabbi yehuda omer: kalbos shel barzel metilin letoch piha, sheim nimchaka megilla veamra "eni shota" — meararin otah umashkin otah beal korchah. amar rabbi akiva: kelum anu tzerichin ella levodkah, vahalo beduka veomedet! ella: ad shello karav hakkometz — yechola lachazor bah, mishshekkarav hakkometz — enah yechola lachazor bah.
Velitamaych, tikshe lach hi gufa: mishshekkarav hakkometz enah yechola lachazor bah? vahalo beduka veomedet!
La kashya: ha — dekahadra ba mechamat retita, veha — dekahadra bah mechamat beriyyuta.

Vehachi kaamar: kol mechamat beriyyuta — kelal kelal la shatya. mechamat retita ad shello karav hakkometz, deakkatti la immechuk megilla, i name immechuk megilla, deshello kedin avud kohanim demachaki — matzya[1] hadra bah. mishshekkarav hakkometz, divdin avud kohanim demachaki — la matze hadra bah.

a: Kashya derabbi akiva adderabbi akiva: hatam amar mechika meakkeva, vehacha amar kometz meakkev!
Tere tannae veallibba derabbi akiva.

Ibbaya lehu: amra eni shota mechamat beriyyuta, vechazra veamra shota ani, mahu? kevan deamra eni shota — temea ani kaamra, vechevan deachzik nafsha betumea, la matzya hadra ba. o dilma kevan deamra shota ani — galliya data demechamat biatuta hu deamra. teku.
Amar avu dishmuel: tzarich sheyyitten mar letoch hammayim. may tama — deamar kera: "me hammarim", shemmarim kevar.

Mishna ad shello nimchaka hammegilla amra "eni shota" — megillatah nignezet, uminchatah mitpazzeret al haddeshen, veen megillatah keshera lehashekot bah sota acheret. nimchaka hammegilla veamra "temea ani" — hammayim nishpachin, uminchatah mitpazzeret al bet haddeshen. nimchaka hammegilla veamra "eni shota" — meararin otah, umashkin otah beal korchah.
Enah maspeket lishtot ad sheppaneha morikot, veeneha boltot, vehi mitmallet gidin. vehem omrim: hotziuha [hotziuha] shello tetamme haazara.

Im yesh lah zechut — hayta tola lah. yesh zechut tola shana achat, yesh zechut tola shete shanim, yesh zechut tola shalosh shanim. mikkan omer ben azzay: chayyayv adam lelammed et bitto tora, sheim tishte teda shehazzechut tola lah. rabbi eliezer omer: kol hamelammed bitto tora — (keillu) lommedah tiflut.
Rabbi yehoshua omer: rotza ishsha bekav vetiflut, mittisha kabbin uferishut. hu haya omer: chasid shote, verasha arum, veishsha perusha, umakkot perushin — hare ellu mevalle olam.

Gemara amar rav yehuda amar shemuel mishshum rabbi meir: keshehayiti lamed tora etzel rabbi akiva, hayiti metil kankantom letoch haddeyo, velo amar li davar. keshebbati etzel rabbi yishmael, amar li: beni ma melachtecha? amarti lo: lavlar ani. amar li: beni, heve zahir, shemmelachtecha melechet shamayim hi, shemma tachsir ot achat o totir ot achat, nimtzeta atta machriv et kol haolam kullo.
Amarti lo: davar echad yesh li sheani metil letoch haddeyo, vekankantom shemo. amar li: vechi metilin kankantom letoch haddeyo? hattora amra "umacha", ketav sheyyuchal limchot!
May kaamar leh umay ka mahdar leh?

Hachi kaamar leh: la mibbaya bachaserot viterot devaki ana, ella afillu lemechash lizvuv dedilma ate veyatev attageh dedalet umachek leh umeshavve leh resh — davar echad yesh li sheani metil letoch haddeyo vekankantom shemo.
Ini? veha tanya, amar rabbi meir: keshehayiti lamed tora etzel rabbi yishmael hayiti metil kankantom letoch haddeyo, velo amar li davar. keshebbati etzel rabbi akiva asarah alay!
Kashya shimmush ashshimmush. kashya asarah aasarah!

Bishlama shimmush ashshimmush la kashya: meikkara ata lekammeh derabbi akiva. kevan dela matze (kam) [lemekam] allibbeh, ata lekammeh derabbi yishmael, ugemar gemara. hadar ata lekammeh derabbi akiva savar sevara.
Ella asarah aasarah kashya! kashya.
Tanya, rabbi yehuda omer, omer haya rabbi meir: lakkol metilin kankantom letoch haddeyo,
b: Chutz mipparashat sota bilvad. rabbi yaakov omer mishshemo: chutz mipparashat sota shel mikdash. may benayyhu? amar rabbi yirmeya: limchok lah min hattora ikka benayyhu.
Vehane tannae chi hane tannae. detanya: en megillatah keshera lehashekot bah sota acheret. rabbi achay bar yoshiyya omer: megillatah keshera lehashekot bah sota acheret.
Amar rav pappa, dilma la hi: ad kan la kaamar tanna kamma hatam, ella kevan deinnetik leshum rachel — la hadra minnatka leshum lea, aval tora, distama ketiva — hachi name demachakinan.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: dilma la hi, ad kan la kaamar rabbi achay bar yoshiyya hatam ella bimgilla, deikketuv leshum alot baolam. aval tora, dilhitlammed ketiva, hachi name dela machakinan.
Verabbi achay bar yoshiyya let leh katav legaresh et ishto venimlach, metzao ben iro veamar lo: shemi keshimcha, veshem ishti keshem ishtecha — pasul legaresh bo?
Amri: hatam "vechatav lah" amar rachamana, bainan ketiva lishmah: hacha name "veasa lah"! may asiyyay — mechika.

Enah maspeket lishtot ad sheppaneha [kulei]. manni — rabbi shimon hi, deamar: makriv et minchatah veachar kach mashkah. dechamma dela karva minchata — la badki la mayya, dichtiv: "minchat zikkaron mazkeret avon",
Ema sefa: yesh lah zechut hayta tola lah, atan lerabbanan, dei rabbi shimon, haamar: en zechut tola bammayim hammarim!
Amar rav chisda: ha manni — rabbi akiva hi, deamar: makriv et minchatah veachar kach mashkah, uvizchut savar la kerabbanan.
Vehem omrim hotziuha vechulei. may tama — dedilma meta. lememra demet asur bemachane leviyya?
Vehatanya: teme met muttar likkanes lemachane leviyya. velo teme met bilvad amru, ella afillu met atzmo, shenneemar: "vayyikkach moshe et atzmot yosef immo", immo bimchitzato!

Amar abbaye: shemma tifros nidda. lememra deviatuta merappeya? in, dichtiv: "vattitchalchal hammalka meod", veamar rav: sheppersa nidda. veha anan tenan: charada mesalleket damim! pachda tzamet, biatuta merappeya.
Yesh lah zechut hayta vechulei. manni matnitin? la abba yose ben chanan, vela rabbi elazar ben yitzchak ish kefar darom, velo rabbi yishmael.

Detanya: im yesh lah zechut tola lah shelosha chodashim, kede hakkarat haubbar, divre abba yose ben chanan. rabbi elazar ben yitzchak ish kefar darom omer: tisha chodashim, shenneemar: "venikketa venizrea zara", ulehallan hu omer: "zera yaavdennu yesuppar", zera harauy lesapper.
Rabbi yishmael omer: shenem asar chodesh. veaf al pi sheen reaya laddavar — zecher laddavar, dichtiv: "lahen malka milki yishpar alaych vachatayach betzidka feruk vaavayatach bemichan anayin
